name: AKLT.Challenge.MainStatementV2
doc:
`t:main`: for every torus with both periods at least three, the VBS vector
is nonzero and spans the kernel. There are a positive constant and one size
threshold above which every nonzero eigenvalue has that uniform lower bound.
Both assertions allow every parity; uniqueness has no eventual-size restriction.
The subtype `Size` already expresses the lower bound three on each period.
source:
def MainStatementV2 : Prop :=
  (∀ L N : Size, B L N ≠ 0 ∧
    LinearMap.ker (H L N) = Submodule.span ℂ {B L N}) ∧
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, 3 ≤ L₀ ∧
    ∀ L N : Size, L₀ ≤ L.val → L₀ ≤ N.val →
      ∀ μ : ℝ, μ ≠ 0 → (H L N).HasEigenvalue (μ : ℂ) → c ≤ μ

name: AKLT.Defs.RawWindow
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: raw words use distinct unoriented bonds, with absolute labels.
source:
def RawWindow {m : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord m) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (wordBond (0, 0) w)

name: AKLT.Defs.MemoryWindow
doc: The actual finite raw state set, not a stored list of purported states.
source: abbrev MemoryWindow (m : ℕ) := {w : DirectionWord m // RawWindow w}

name: AKLT.Defs.windowArrival
doc: Last absolute direction, with an irrelevant totalization at memory zero.
source:
def windowArrival {m : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord m) : Compass :=
  if h : 0 < m then w ⟨m - 1, by omega⟩ else .east

name: AKLT.Defs.windowSuccessor
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: append and forget the oldest direction.
source:
def windowSuccessor {m : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord m) (d : Compass) : DirectionWord m :=
  fun i => if h : i.val + 1 < m then w ⟨i.val + 1, h⟩ else d

name: AKLT.Defs.WindowAdmissible
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: initial reversal and every remembered used bond are excluded.

name: AKLT.Defs.StepKind
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: the three detected departure kinds.
source:
inductive StepKind where
  | straight | turn | revisit
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.windowKind
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: revisit detection precedes straight/turn detection.

name: AKLT.Defs.kindWeight
doc: `d:memorygrowth`: the exact one-step weights, with true revisit factor 1/5.
source:
def kindWeight : StepKind → ℚ
  | .straight => passageFactor true / 3
  | .turn => passageFactor false / 3
  | .revisit => 1 / 5

name: AKLT.Defs.memoryMatrix
doc: `d:memorygrowth`: the regenerated raw matrix, rather than trusted matrix data.
source:
def memoryMatrix (m : ℕ) (ω ω' : MemoryWindow m) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ d : Compass, if WindowAdmissible ω.val d ∧ windowSuccessor ω.val d = ω'.val
    then kindWeight (windowKind ω.val d) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.lastWindowWord
doc: `d:memorygrowth`: true length-n weight ending in a specified last window.
source:
def lastWindowWord {n : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (w : DirectionWord n) : DirectionWord m :=
  fun i => if h : n - m + i.val < n then w ⟨n - m + i.val, h⟩ else .east

name: AKLT.Defs.memoryTrailMass
doc: True trail mass assigned to a raw memory window; used only when n is at least m.
source:
def memoryTrailMass (m n : ℕ) (u : Plane) (incoming : Compass) (ω : MemoryWindow m) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ w : DirectionWord n, if IsTrail u incoming w ∧ lastWindowWord m w = ω.val
    then trailWeight u incoming w else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.MemoryQuotient
doc: `l:automaton-quotient`: finite quotient data, with no correctness assumed in its fields.
source:
structure MemoryQuotient (m q : ℕ) where
  project : DirectionWord m → Fin q
  representative : Fin q → DirectionWord m
  allowed : Fin q → Compass → Bool
  kind : Fin q → Compass → StepKind
  successor : Fin q → Compass → Fin q
  arrival : Fin q → Compass

name: AKLT.Defs.MemoryQuotient.Correct
doc: `l:automaton-quotient`: every required raw-to-quotient check, including nonrevisit arrivals.
source:
def MemoryQuotient.Correct {m q : ℕ} (Q : MemoryQuotient m q) : Prop :=
  (∀ a, RawWindow (Q.representative a) ∧ Q.project (Q.representative a) = a) ∧
  ∀ w : DirectionWord m, RawWindow w → ∀ d : Compass,
    (Q.allowed (Q.project w) d = true ↔ WindowAdmissible w d) ∧
    (WindowAdmissible w d → Q.kind (Q.project w) d = windowKind w d ∧
      Q.successor (Q.project w) d = Q.project (windowSuccessor w d) ∧
      (windowKind w d ≠ .revisit → Q.arrival (Q.project w) = windowArrival w))

name: AKLT.Defs.CompatibleProjection
doc:
`l:automaton-quotient`: the raw hypotheses on a surjective class map,
before choosing representatives and labelled quotient transitions.
source:
def CompatibleProjection (m q : ℕ) (π : DirectionWord m → Fin q) : Prop :=
  (∀ a, ∃ w, RawWindow w ∧ π w = a) ∧
  ∀ w w' : DirectionWord m, RawWindow w → RawWindow w' → π w = π w' →
    (∀ d : Compass, (WindowAdmissible w d ↔ WindowAdmissible w' d) ∧
      windowKind w d = windowKind w' d ∧
      (WindowAdmissible w d → π (windowSuccessor w d) = π (windowSuccessor w' d))) ∧
    ((∃ d, WindowAdmissible w d ∧ windowKind w d ≠ .revisit) → windowArrival w = windowArrival w')

name: AKLT.Defs.quotientEdgeCount
doc: `p:automaton10`: counts of labelled quotient edges, regenerated from admissibility/kind.
source:
def quotientEdgeCount {m q : ℕ} (Q : MemoryQuotient m q) (k : StepKind) : ℕ :=
  (Finset.univ.filter fun e : Fin q × Compass => Q.allowed e.1 e.2 ∧ Q.kind e.1 e.2 = k).card

name: AKLT.Defs.SquareSymmetry
doc: `l:H2-dihedral`: the eight lattice symmetries as optional reflection followed by quarter turns.
source: abbrev SquareSymmetry := Fin 4 × Bool

name: AKLT.Defs.turnLeft
doc: Direction action used to check the dihedral reduction without a supplied orbit list.
source:
def turnLeft : Compass → Compass
  | .east => .north | .north => .west | .west => .south | .south => .east

name: AKLT.Defs.reflectDirection
source:
def reflectDirection : Compass → Compass
  | .north => .south | .south => .north | d => d

name: AKLT.Defs.symmetryDirection
source:
def symmetryDirection (g : SquareSymmetry) (d : Compass) : Compass :=
  (turnLeft^[g.1.val]) (if g.2 then reflectDirection d else d)

name: AKLT.Defs.symmetryWord
doc: The induced componentwise action on raw words.
source:
def symmetryWord {m : ℕ} (g : SquareSymmetry) (w : DirectionWord m) : DirectionWord m :=
  fun i => symmetryDirection g (w i)

name: AKLT.Defs.SameWindowOrbit
doc: Same dihedral orbit, expressed by one of the eight actual symmetries.
source:
def SameWindowOrbit {m : ℕ} (w w' : DirectionWord m) : Prop :=
  ∃ g : SquareSymmetry, symmetryWord g w = w'

name: AKLT.Defs.openTrailTotal
doc: `l:alm`: exact true open-trail total with prescribed initial data.
source:
def openTrailTotal (n : ℕ) (u : Plane) (incoming : Compass) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ w : DirectionWord n, if IsTrail u incoming w then trailWeight u incoming w else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.memoryWitnessRatio
doc: `l:alm`: the max/min witness ratio over the actual raw state type.
source:
def memoryWitnessRatio {m : ℕ} (v : MemoryWindow m → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  sSup (Set.range v) / sInf (Set.range v)

name: AKLT.Defs.memoryBaseConstant
doc: `l:alm`: the displayed finite base constant, with one fixed start and incoming direction.

name: AKLT.Defs.rawBackward
doc: `l:automaton-quotient`: a general finite-phase raw backward operator.
source:
def rawBackward (m p : ℕ)
    (weight : Fin p → Fin p → StepKind → Compass → Compass → Plane → ℚ)
    (terminal : Plane → Bool) (F : Fin p → DirectionWord m → Plane → ℚ)
    (φ : Fin p) (w : DirectionWord m) (x : Plane) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact if terminal x then 0 else ∑ d : Compass, ∑ ψ : Fin p,
    if WindowAdmissible w d then weight φ ψ (windowKind w d) d (windowArrival w) x *
      F ψ (windowSuccessor w d) (x + d.step) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.quotientBackward
doc: The matching quotient backward operator. Coefficients cannot inspect forgotten raw data.
source:
def quotientBackward {m q : ℕ} (Q : MemoryQuotient m q) (p : ℕ)
    (weight : Fin p → Fin p → StepKind → Compass → Compass → Plane → ℚ)
    (terminal : Plane → Bool) (F : Fin p → Fin q → Plane → ℚ)
    (φ : Fin p) (a : Fin q) (x : Plane) : ℚ :=
  if terminal x then 0 else ∑ d : Compass, ∑ ψ : Fin p,
    if Q.allowed a d then weight φ ψ (Q.kind a d) d (Q.arrival a) x *
      F ψ (Q.successor a d) (x + d.step) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.finiteOperatorSum
doc: Finite sums of iterates, used for stopped continuation weights with no resolvent premise.
source:
def finiteOperatorSum {α : Type*} (T : (α → ℚ) → (α → ℚ)) (g : α → ℚ) (R : ℕ) (s : α) : ℚ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (R + 1), (T^[j]) g s

name: AKLT.Defs.appendWords
doc: Concatenation of finite compass words; all used-bond checks remain on the whole word.
source:
def appendWords {n r : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (v : DirectionWord r) : DirectionWord (n + r) :=
  fun i => if h : i.val < n then w ⟨i.val, h⟩ else v ⟨i.val - n, by omega⟩

name: AKLT.Defs.takeWord
doc: A prefix word, used only at L<=n; the default makes the indexing definition total.
source:
def takeWord {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (L : ℕ) : DirectionWord L :=
  fun i => if h : i.val < n then w ⟨i.val, h⟩ else .east

name: AKLT.Defs.truePhaseCoefficient
doc: The actual phase transition at one departure of a true word.

name: AKLT.Defs.longOrdering
doc: `l:phase-expansion`: the straight-first ordering used for every long closed trail.

name: AKLT.Defs.truePhaseSuffix
doc: Exact phase contribution of a suffix, from one specified prefix phase.

name: AKLT.Defs.trueContinuationSum
doc: `l:stationary-domination`: the complete true suffix sum through a finite horizon.
source:
def trueContinuationSum {L : ℕ} (X : PairType) (P : DirectionWord L) (φ : Phase) (R : ℕ) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ r ∈ Finset.range (R + 1), ∑ v : DirectionWord r,
    if ClosedTrail X (appendWords P v) then truePhaseSuffix (appendWords P v) L φ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryReward
doc: The stationary terminal reward is supported only on the target.
source:
def stationaryReward (X : PairType) (φ : Phase) (_a : Fin 3741) (x : Plane) : ℚ :=
  if x = kernelTarget X then phaseTerminal φ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryContinuationSum
doc: Finite stationary continuation sum on the actual lattice.

name: AKLT.Defs.listBackward
doc: `l:Bellman-soundness`: a finitely branching operator specified by finite edge lists.
source:
def listBackward {α : Type*} (edges : α → List (α × ℝ)) (F : α → ℝ) (s : α) : ℝ :=
  ((edges s).map fun e => e.2 * F e.1).sum

name: AKLT.Defs.Network
doc:
`d:domain`: status and kept sets on an original finite G. No mass field is present.
Validity is an explicit predicate, so an auxiliary terminal network is never silently ordinary.
source:
structure Network (G : Finset Plane) where
  status : Plane → Status
  kept : Plane → Finset Plane

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.active
doc: `d:domain`: nonremoved sites of the original volume.
source:
def Network.active {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : Finset Plane :=
  G.filter fun x => D.status x ≠ .X

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.Present
doc: A bond is present exactly when both active endpoints keep it.
source:
def Network.Present {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (x y : Plane) : Prop :=
  x ∈ D.active ∧ y ∈ D.active ∧ Adjacent x y ∧ y ∈ D.kept x ∧ x ∈ D.kept y

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.bonds
doc: The finite set of present bonds, each counted once.
source:
def Network.bonds {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : Finset (Plane × Plane) :=
  (internalBonds G).filter fun e => D.Present e.1 e.2

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.presentNeighbours
doc: Present degree counts actual bonds, not merely kept half-edges.
source:
def Network.presentNeighbours {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (x : Plane) : Finset Plane :=
  (neighbours x).filter fun y => D.Present x y

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.LocalRules
doc: Common local restrictions for ordinary and auxiliary networks.
source:
def Network.LocalRules {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, x ∉ G → D.status x = .X) ∧
  (∀ x, D.kept x ⊆ neighbours x ∩ G) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ G, D.status x = .D → (D.presentNeighbours x).card ≤ 2) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ D.active, (D.presentNeighbours x).card +
    ((originalLegs G).filter fun e => e.1 = x).card ≤ 4)

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.Ordinary
doc: `d:domain`: an ordinary domain protects original S(G), including all its kept bonds.

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.Auxiliary
doc: `d:domain`: auxiliary networks permit protected kept-set defects, retaining all original legs.
source:
def Network.Auxiliary {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : Prop :=
  D.LocalRules ∧ ∀ x ∈ protectedSites G, D.status x = .U

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.Consistent
doc: `d:domain`: the ordinary consistent class, including the corrected mutual-kept rule.
source:
def Network.Consistent {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : Prop :=
  D.Ordinary ∧
  (∀ x ∈ G, D.status x = .U → D.kept x = neighbours x ∩ G) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ G, D.status x = .D → (D.kept x).card = 2) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ D.active, ∀ y ∈ D.active, Adjacent x y → (y ∈ D.kept x ↔ x ∈ D.kept y)

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.spins
doc: Spin coordinates on the active sites, extended only for indexing at removed sites.

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.partition
doc: `d:domain`: finite partition functional, with every surviving original leg retained.
source:
def Network.partition {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (pinned : Bool) (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n : (x : D.active) → SpinLetter,
    (∏ x : D.active, spinWeight (D.status x.val) (n x)) * f (D.spins n) *
    (∏ e ∈ D.bonds, (1 + dot (D.spins n e.1) (D.spins n e.2))) *
    ∏ e : originalLegs G,
      if pinned = true ∧ e.val.1 ∈ D.active then
        1 + dot (τ e).val (D.spins n e.val.1) else 1

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.expectation
doc: `d:domain`: normalized expectation in either the pinned or free network.

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.ratio
doc: `d:domain`: pinned/free partition ratio, with unchanged original G and pins.
source:
def Network.ratio {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (τ : PinAssignment G) : ℝ :=
  D.partition τ true (fun _ => 1) / D.partition τ false (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.AdmissibleStart
doc: `d:trace`: only the two admissible start cases used in the proof.
source:
def Network.AdmissibleStart {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (u : Plane) : Prop :=
  u ∈ D.active ∧ u ∉ protectedSites G ∧
    ((D.status u = .U ∧ (D.presentNeighbours u).card ≤ 3) ∨
      (D.status u = .D ∧ (D.presentNeighbours u).card ≤ 1))

name: AKLT.Defs.traceStep
doc: `d:trace`: drop the traversed bond at both ends, then U becomes D and D becomes X.
source:
def traceStep {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (y o : Plane) : Network G where
  status := Function.update D.status y (if D.status y = .U then .D else .X)
  kept := fun x => if x = y then (D.kept x).erase o
    else if x = o then (D.kept x).erase y else D.kept x

name: AKLT.Defs.traceNetwork
doc: `d:trace`: the trace along a finite vertex list, including the length-zero convention.
source:
def traceNetwork {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : List Plane → Network G
  | y :: o :: rest => traceNetwork (traceStep D y o) (o :: rest)
  | _ => D

name: AKLT.Defs.traceCoefficient
doc: `d:trace`: mass-free coefficient, recording status at departure in the evolving network.
source:
def traceCoefficient {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) : List Plane → ℚ
  | y :: o :: rest => (if D.status y = .U then 1 / 3 else if D.status y = .D then 1 / 5 else 0) *
      traceCoefficient (traceStep D y o) (o :: rest)
  | _ => 1

name: AKLT.Defs.traceRatio
doc: `d:trace`: the partition ratio along a traced path, for either pin choice.

name: AKLT.Defs.PairType
doc: `d:pairenv`: the two pair types, collinear B and diagonal C.
source:
inductive PairType where
  | B | C
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.HasPairType
doc: `d:pairenv`: endpoint geometry, with all distances ambient.
source:
def HasPairType (X : PairType) (u v : Plane) : Prop :=
  latticeDist u v = 2 ∧ (if X = .B then u.1 = v.1 ∨ u.2 = v.2 else u.1 ≠ v.1 ∧ u.2 ≠ v.2)

name: AKLT.Defs.Network.ResponsePair
doc: `d:pairenv`: the ordinary response-pair class with its designated removed centre.
source:
def Network.ResponsePair {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (X : PairType)
    (u v c : Plane) : Prop :=
  D.Consistent ∧ u ∈ D.active ∧ v ∈ D.active ∧ c ∈ G ∧ D.status c = .X ∧
  Adjacent u c ∧ Adjacent v c ∧ HasPairType X u v ∧
  (D.status u = .U ∨ (D.status u = .D ∧ (D.presentNeighbours u).card ≤ 1)) ∧
  (D.status v = .U ∨ (D.status v = .D ∧ (D.presentNeighbours v).card ≤ 1))

name: AKLT.Defs.responseEnvelope
doc: `d:pairenv`: bounded ordinary-domain response envelope, never over auxiliary networks.
source:
def responseEnvelope (X : PairType) (d : ℤ) : ℝ :=
  sSup ({0} ∪ {r | ∃ G : Finset Plane, ∃ τ : PinAssignment G, ∃ D : Network G,
    ∃ u v c : Plane, D.ResponsePair X u v c ∧
    (d.toNat : ℕ∞) ≤ min (setDistance latticeDist u (↑(protectedSites G) : Set Plane))
      (setDistance latticeDist v (↑(protectedSites G) : Set Plane)) ∧
    r = |D.expectation τ true (fun n => dot (n u) (n v)) -
      D.expectation τ false (fun n => dot (n u) (n v))|})

name: AKLT.Defs.FiniteSpinNetwork
doc: `l:finitefacts`: arbitrary finite active spin networks, including covered local templates.
source:
structure FiniteSpinNetwork (n : ℕ) where
  status : Fin n → Status
  bonds : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)
  pinCount : Fin n → ℕ
  pin : (x : Fin n) → Fin (pinCount x) → UnitVector

name: AKLT.Defs.FiniteSpinNetwork.Valid
doc: Exactly the degree and distinct-endpoint conditions used in finite positivity.
source:
def FiniteSpinNetwork.Valid {n : ℕ} (D : FiniteSpinNetwork n) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, D.status x = .U ∨ D.status x = .D) ∧
  (∀ e ∈ D.bonds, e.1 < e.2) ∧
  ∀ x, (D.bonds.filter fun e => e.1 = x ∨ e.2 = x).card + D.pinCount x ≤ 4

name: AKLT.Defs.FiniteSpinNetwork.weight
doc: The finite unnormalized weight, with every specified pin factor.
source:
def FiniteSpinNetwork.weight {n : ℕ} (D : FiniteSpinNetwork n) (pinned : Bool)
    (σ : Fin n → SpinLetter) : ℝ :=
  (∏ x, spinWeight (D.status x) (σ x)) *
  (∏ e ∈ D.bonds, (1 + dot (spinVector (σ e.1)) (spinVector (σ e.2)))) *
  ∏ x, ∏ j : Fin (D.pinCount x),
    if pinned then 1 + dot (D.pin x j).val (spinVector (σ x)) else 1

name: AKLT.Defs.FiniteSpinNetwork.partition
doc: Generic finite partition functional.

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionalProbability
doc: Conditional probability of an event given a positive-probability event.
source:
def conditionalProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω)
    (E A : Ω → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact (∑ σ, if E σ ∧ A σ then p σ else 0) / ∑ σ, if E σ then p σ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionOn
doc: Conditioning weights, without pretending that a zero-probability fibre is defined probabilistically.
source:
def conditionOn {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) (E : Ω → Prop) : Weight Ω := by
  classical
  exact normalize fun σ => if E σ then p σ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.eventMass
doc: Finite event mass, independent of any measure-theory interface.
source:
def eventMass {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) (E : Ω → Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ σ, if E σ then p σ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.localProduct
doc: `l:35`: finite one-site product and normalized vector mean.
source:
def localProduct {k : ℕ} (a : Fin k → Vec3) (n : Vec3) : ℝ :=
  ∏ j, (1 + dot n (a j))

name: AKLT.Defs.localMean
source:
def localMean {k : ℕ} (s : Status) (a : Fin k → Vec3) : Vec3 :=
  fun i => siteFunctional s (fun n => n i * localProduct a n) / siteFunctional s (localProduct a)

name: AKLT.Defs.evaluateReduced
doc: Complex and rational polynomial evaluations used in the operator interfaces.
source:
def evaluateReduced (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) (u : Fin 20 → Vec3) : ℝ :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂ (Rat.castHom ℝ) (fun v => u v.1 v.2) p

doc: `d:Pauli`: product density in the same finite tensor coordinates as the operator.

name: AKLT.Defs.invertVectors
doc: `d:Pauli`: inversion on vector data, exactly matching `invertPolynomial`.
source:
def invertVectors (I : Finset (Fin 20)) (u : Fin 20 → Vec3) : Fin 20 → Vec3 :=
  fun j => if j ∈ I then -u j else u j

name: AKLT.Defs.exchangeSpace
doc: `d:exchange`: supported sector as an ambient subspace with its inherited Hilbert norm.
source:
def exchangeSpace (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π) :
    Submodule ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (reductionVectors π r → Fin 2)) :=
  Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range fun b : ExchangeBasis π r ε =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun σ => (exchangeBasisVector π r ε b σ : ℂ)))

name: AKLT.Defs.tokenMatrix

name: AKLT.Defs.totalSpinZ
doc: `d:Pauli`: the three ladder operators in actual tensor coordinates.
source:

  Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : J, tokenMatrix J j (pauli 3))

name: AKLT.Defs.totalSpinPlus
source:
def totalSpinPlus (J : Finset (Fin 20)) : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (J → Fin 2)) :=
  Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : J, tokenMatrix J j (pauli 1 + Complex.I • pauli 2))

name: AKLT.Defs.totalSpinMinus
source:
def totalSpinMinus (J : Finset (Fin 20)) : Module.End ℂ (EuclideanSpace ℂ (J → Fin 2)) :=
  Matrix.toEuclideanLin ((1 / 2 : ℂ) • ∑ j : J, tokenMatrix J j (pauli 1 - Complex.I • pauli 2))
