name: AKLT.Defs.FrameData
doc: `d:frame`: finite frame data, before any moment or positivity assertion.
source:
structure FrameData (n : ℕ) where
  point : Fin n → Vec3
  weight : Fin n → ℝ

name: AKLT.Defs.IsFrame
doc: `d:frame`: precisely the positive degree-four moment-frame property.
source:
def IsFrame {n : ℕ} (F : FrameData n) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective F.point ∧ (∀ j, normSq (F.point j) = 1) ∧
  (∀ j, 0 < F.weight j) ∧ (∑ j, F.weight j) = 1 ∧
  ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, DegreeFour p →
    (∑ j, F.weight j * MvPolynomial.eval (F.point j) p) =
      moment (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval a p)

name: AKLT.Defs.MomentLaw
doc: `l:exact`: a weighted moment law may repeat atoms; injectivity is not required.
source:
def MomentLaw {n : ℕ} (F : FrameData n) : Prop :=
  (∀ j, normSq (F.point j) = 1) ∧ (∀ j, 0 < F.weight j) ∧ (∑ j, F.weight j) = 1 ∧
  ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, DegreeFour p →
    (∑ j, F.weight j * MvPolynomial.eval (F.point j) p) = moment (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval a p)

name: AKLT.Defs.momentLawFunctional
doc: `l:exact`: arbitrary finite moment law, optionally mixed with the zero atom.

name: AKLT.Defs.frameRotation
doc: `l:threeframes`: the frozen rational rotation.

name: AKLT.Defs.frameVector
doc: `l:threeframes`: the actual vector in rotated alphabet `j`.
source:
def frameVector (j : Fin 3) (a : IcoLetter) : Vec3 :=
  (frameRotation ^ j.val).mulVec (icoVector a)

name: AKLT.Defs.frameBound
doc: `l:threeframes`: the attained common interaction lower bound.
source: def frameBound : ℝ := (5 - Real.sqrt 5) / 505

name: AKLT.Defs.frameRatio
doc: `l:threeframes`: the single-bond density ratio.
source: def frameRatio : ℝ := frameBound / (2 - frameBound)

name: AKLT.Defs.frameEnergy
doc: `l:planeenergy`: finite energy for admissible frame letters only.
source: def frameEnergy : ℝ := (1 / 12) * frameRatio ^ 4

name: AKLT.Defs.Spinor
doc: `d:poly`: spinors have two complex coordinates.
source: abbrev Spinor := Fin 2 → ℂ

name: AKLT.Defs.pauli
doc: `d:Pauli`: identity and the three Pauli matrices, in x,y,z order.

name: AKLT.Defs.spinDensity
doc: `d:Pauli`: the product-density building block `(I+a.sigma)/2`.
source:
def spinDensity (a : Vec3) : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (1 + ∑ k : Fin 3, (a k : ℂ) • pauli ⟨k.val + 1, by omega⟩)

name: AKLT.Defs.frameSpinor
doc:
`d:poly`: an explicit choice on the finite family of frame letters only.
The pole branch avoids division by zero; its required identities are in `TightStatement`.
source:
def frameSpinor (j : Fin 3) (a : IcoLetter) : Spinor :=
  let v := frameVector j a
  if v 2 = -1 then ![0, 1] else
    ![(Real.sqrt ((1 + v 2) / 2) : ℂ),
      ((v 0 : ℂ) + Complex.I * (v 1 : ℂ)) / (Real.sqrt (2 * (1 + v 2)) : ℂ)]

name: AKLT.Defs.ProperPlaneColouring
doc: `d:framemodel`: a proper plane colouring is quantified, not assumed translation invariant.
source:
def ProperPlaneColouring (κ : Plane → Fin 3) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y, Adjacent x y → κ x ≠ κ y

name: AKLT.Defs.ProperTorusColouring
doc: `d:framemodel`: proper colouring on the actual frozen torus bonds.

name: AKLT.Defs.PlaneConfiguration
doc: A finite configuration of actual frame-letter labels.
source: abbrev PlaneConfiguration (W : Finset Plane) := (x : W) → IcoLetter

name: AKLT.Defs.exteriorSites
doc: The finite exterior neighbour sites; a boundary uses one letter per site.
source: def exteriorSites (W : Finset Plane) : Finset Plane := (originalLegs W).image Prod.snd

name: AKLT.Defs.FrameBoundary
doc: `d:framemodel`: admissible boundaries, distinct from unrelated original-leg pins.
source: abbrev FrameBoundary (W : Finset Plane) := (z : exteriorSites W) → IcoLetter

name: AKLT.Defs.extendLetters
doc:
Extension outside the requested finite configuration is used only for indexing.
All interactions in a partition product use sites of its actual configuration.
source:
def extendLetters {W : Finset Plane} (σ : PlaneConfiguration W) (x : Plane) : IcoLetter :=
  if h : x ∈ W then σ ⟨x, h⟩ else (0, 0, 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.extendBoundary
doc: Finite boundary extension for leg indexing.
source:
def extendBoundary {W : Finset Plane} (η : FrameBoundary W) (x : Plane) : IcoLetter :=
  if h : x ∈ exteriorSites W then η ⟨x, h⟩ else (0, 0, 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.planeWeight
doc: `d:framemodel`: the unnormalized ferromagnetic plane specification.
source:
def planeWeight (κ : Plane → Fin 3) (W : Finset Plane) (η : FrameBoundary W)
    (σ : PlaneConfiguration W) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ W.card *
  (∏ e ∈ internalBonds W, (1 + dot (frameVector (κ e.1) (extendLetters σ e.1))
      (frameVector (κ e.2) (extendLetters σ e.2)))) *
  ∏ e ∈ originalLegs W, (1 + dot (frameVector (κ e.1) (extendLetters σ e.1))
      (frameVector (κ e.2) (extendBoundary η e.2)))

name: AKLT.Defs.planeLaw
doc: `d:framemodel`: the normalized plane law, with its actual normalizer.
source:
def planeLaw (κ : Plane → Fin 3) (W : Finset Plane) (η : FrameBoundary W) :
    Weight (PlaneConfiguration W) := normalize (planeWeight κ W η)

name: AKLT.Defs.marginal
doc: Finite pushforward, used for window marginals.
source:
def marginal {Ω Ξ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ξ]
    (p : Weight Ω) (r : Ω → Ξ) : Weight Ξ := fun z => ∑ x, if r x = z then p x else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.planeMarginal
doc: `d:W`: the actual B marginal; there is no identification across alphabets.

name: AKLT.Defs.TorusConfiguration
doc: `d:framemodel`: finite torus frame configurations.
source: abbrev TorusConfiguration (L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size) := AKLT.Challenge.Site L N → IcoLetter

name: AKLT.Defs.torusWeight
doc: `d:framemodel`: antiferromagnetic torus weight with one factor per frozen bond.
source:
def torusWeight (L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size) (κ : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N → Fin 3)
    (σ : TorusConfiguration L N) : ℝ :=
  (∏ _x : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N, (1 / 12 : ℝ)) *
    ∏ e : AKLT.Challenge.Bond L N,
      (1 - dot (frameVector (κ e.1) (σ e.1))
        (frameVector (κ (AKLT.Challenge.nextSite e.1 e.2)) (σ (AKLT.Challenge.nextSite e.1 e.2))))

name: AKLT.Defs.torusLaw
doc: `d:framemodel`: the normalized all-parity torus law.
source:
def torusLaw (L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size) (κ : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N → Fin 3) :
    Weight (TorusConfiguration L N) := normalize (torusWeight L N κ)

name: AKLT.Defs.torusReference
doc: `l:tight`: unnormalized product reference weight, including the factor five per site.
source:
def torusReference (L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size) : Weight (TorusConfiguration L N) :=
  fun _ => ∏ _x : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N, (5 / 12 : ℝ)

name: AKLT.Defs.frameEval
doc: `l:tight`: evaluation at the finitely chosen frame spinors.

name: AKLT.Defs.WindowProperty
doc: `d:W`: the entire uniform physical-site window property, with all colourings and translates.
source:
def WindowProperty (l₀ : ℕ) (p₀ : ℝ) (Mstar : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ l₀ ∧ 1 ≤ Mstar ∧ 0 < p₀ ∧ p₀ ≤ 1 ∧
  ∀ κ : Plane → Fin 3, ProperPlaneColouring κ → ∀ a : Plane,
    ∀ u : ℕ, Mstar ≤ u → ∀ y : Plane,
    setDistance supDist y (↑(square a u) : Set Plane) = 1 →
    ∀ i : ℤ, 2 ≤ i → (i : ℝ) ≤ shellSpacing u → i ∉ exceptionalIndices a y u →
    ∀ η ξ : FrameBoundary (farVolume a y u i),
      totalVariation (planeMarginal κ (farVolume a y u i) (window a y u l₀ i) η)
        (planeMarginal κ (farVolume a y u i) (window a y u l₀ i) ξ) ≤ 1 - p₀

name: AKLT.Defs.Plane
doc: `d:moment`: the ambient plane, never a quotient in the analytic lanes.
source: abbrev Plane := ℤ × ℤ

name: AKLT.Defs.latticeDist
doc: `d:moment`: ambient nearest-neighbour distance.
source: def latticeDist (x y : Plane) : ℕ := (x.1 - y.1).natAbs + (x.2 - y.2).natAbs

name: AKLT.Defs.supDist
doc: `d:moment`: ambient maximum-coordinate distance.
source: def supDist (x y : Plane) : ℕ := max (x.1 - y.1).natAbs (x.2 - y.2).natAbs

name: AKLT.Defs.Compass
doc: `d:memory-automaton`: absolute compass directions.
source:
inductive Compass where
  | east | north | west | south
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.Compass.step
doc: The unit displacement of an absolute direction.
source:
def Compass.step : Compass → Plane
  | .east => (1, 0)
  | .north => (0, 1)
  | .west => (-1, 0)
  | .south => (0, -1)

name: AKLT.Defs.Compass.reverse
doc: Reversal of an absolute direction.
source:
def Compass.reverse : Compass → Compass
  | .east => .west
  | .north => .south
  | .west => .east
  | .south => .north

name: AKLT.Defs.Adjacent
doc: Nearest-neighbour adjacency, always in the ambient plane.
source: def Adjacent (x y : Plane) : Prop := latticeDist x y = 1

name: AKLT.Defs.neighbours
doc: Four physical neighbours.
source: def neighbours (x : Plane) : Finset Plane := Finset.univ.image (fun d : Compass => x + d.step)

name: AKLT.Defs.positiveNeighbours
doc: The positive orientations, used solely to count each internal bond once.
source: def positiveNeighbours (x : Plane) : Finset Plane := {(x.1 + 1, x.2), (x.1, x.2 + 1)}

name: AKLT.Defs.internalBonds
doc: `d:pinmodel`: each internal unoriented edge, indexed once.
source:
def internalBonds (G : Finset Plane) : Finset (Plane × Plane) :=
  G.biUnion fun x => (positiveNeighbours x ∩ G).image (fun y => (x, y))

name: AKLT.Defs.originalLegs
doc: `d:pinmodel`: original legs, before any removals.
source:
def originalLegs (G : Finset Plane) : Finset (Plane × Plane) :=
  G.biUnion fun x => (neighbours x \ G).image (fun z => (x, z))

name: AKLT.Defs.setDistance
doc: `d:moment`: distance to a set, including value infinity for the empty set.
source:
noncomputable def setDistance (metric : Plane → Plane → ℕ) (x : Plane)
    (S : Set Plane) : ℕ∞ := ⨅ y : S, (metric x y.val : ℕ∞)

name: AKLT.Defs.boundaryDepth
doc: Distance to the original exterior of a finite volume.
source:
noncomputable def boundaryDepth (G : Finset Plane) (x : Plane) : ℕ∞ :=
  setDistance latticeDist x {z | z ∉ G}

name: AKLT.Defs.protectedSites
doc: `d:pinmodel`: the protected layer of width two in the original volume.
source:
noncomputable def protectedSites (G : Finset Plane) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact G.filter fun x => boundaryDepth G x ≤ 2

name: AKLT.Defs.decay
doc: Exponential decay at an extended natural distance; its value at infinity is zero.
source: noncomputable def decay (θ : ℝ) (r : ℕ∞) : ℝ := if r = ⊤ then 0 else θ ^ r.toNat

name: AKLT.Defs.square
doc: `d:shells`: the translated physical square of integer radius `u`.

name: AKLT.Defs.squareCorners
doc: The four corner sites, including their actual translated coordinates.
source:
def squareCorners (a : Plane) (u : ℕ) : Finset Plane :=
  ({a.1 - (u : ℤ), a.1 + u} : Finset ℤ).product {a.2 - (u : ℤ), a.2 + u}

name: AKLT.Defs.shellSpacing
doc: `d:shells`: shell spacing `u^(1/4)`, with no integer rounding.
source: noncomputable def shellSpacing (u : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (Real.sqrt u)

name: AKLT.Defs.shellRadius
doc: `d:shells`: the integer radius `floor(i s)`.
source: noncomputable def shellRadius (u : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : ℤ := ⌊(i : ℝ) * shellSpacing u⌋

name: AKLT.Defs.lastShellIndex
doc: `d:shells`: the largest trial index, `floor(s)+1`.
source: noncomputable def lastShellIndex (u : ℕ) : ℤ := ⌊shellSpacing u⌋ + 1

name: AKLT.Defs.farVolume
doc: `d:shells`: the remaining far volume `F_i`.
source:
noncomputable def farVolume (a y : Plane) (u : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact (square a u).filter fun x => ((i : ℝ) - 1) * shellSpacing u < supDist x y

name: AKLT.Defs.shell
doc: `d:shells`: the physical shell `D_i`.
source:
noncomputable def shell (a y : Plane) (u : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact (square a u).filter fun x => (supDist x y : ℤ) = shellRadius u i

name: AKLT.Defs.nearShell
doc: `d:shells`: the part `A_i` near the exterior of the original square.
source:
noncomputable def nearShell (a y : Plane) (u l₀ : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact (shell a y u i).filter fun x =>
    setDistance supDist x {z | z ∉ square a u} ≤ (l₀ : ℕ∞)

name: AKLT.Defs.window
doc: `d:shells`: the physical window `B_i`.
source:
noncomputable def window (a y : Plane) (u l₀ : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : Finset Plane :=
  shell a y u i \ nearShell a y u l₀ i

name: AKLT.Defs.exceptionalIndices
doc: `d:shells`: the exceptional integer indices near corner sites.
source:
noncomputable def exceptionalIndices (a y : Plane) (u : ℕ) : Finset ℤ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.Icc 2 (lastShellIndex u)).filter fun i =>
    ∃ x ∈ shell a y u i, ∃ z ∈ squareCorners a u,
      (supDist x z : ℝ) < shellSpacing u / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.geometryThreshold
doc: `l:shellgeom`: its purely geometric size threshold.
source: def geometryThreshold (l₀ : ℕ) : ℕ := (max 16 (6 * (l₀ + 1))) ^ 4

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelStart
doc: `d:kernel`: the fixed start, centre, target and incoming direction of each row.
source: def kernelStart : Plane := (-1, 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelCentre
source: def kernelCentre : Plane := (0, 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelTarget
source: def kernelTarget : PairType → Plane | .B => (1, 0) | .C => (0, 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelIncoming
source: def kernelIncoming : Compass := .west

name: AKLT.Defs.ClosedTrail
doc: `d:kernel`: first hit of v, avoiding c, with no used unoriented bond repeated.
source:
def ClosedTrail {n : ℕ} (X : PairType) (w : DirectionWord n) : Prop :=
  IsTrail kernelStart kernelIncoming w ∧ wordVertex kernelStart w n = kernelTarget X ∧
  (∀ j ≤ n, wordVertex kernelStart w j ≠ kernelCentre) ∧
  ∀ j < n, wordVertex kernelStart w j ≠ kernelTarget X

name: AKLT.Defs.deadAt
doc: `d:kernel`: dead sites are the centre and sites with two previous departures.
source:
def deadAt {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) (z : Plane) : Prop :=
  z = kernelCentre ∨ 2 ≤ departureCount kernelStart w i.val z

name: AKLT.Defs.responseNeighbours
doc: `d:kernel`: the three nonarrival neighbours, with the actual outgoing neighbour distinguished.

name: AKLT.Defs.liveOtherNeighbours
doc: Live non-outgoing neighbours; this is where the beta-prime case is decided.
source:
def liveOtherNeighbours {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact ((responseNeighbours w i).erase (wordVertex kernelStart w (i.val + 1))).filter
    fun z => ¬ deadAt w i z

name: AKLT.Defs.responsePairs
doc: `d:kernel`: live response pairs, represented as two-element finite sets.
source:
def responsePairs {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Finset (Finset Plane) :=
  (insert (wordVertex kernelStart w (i.val + 1)) (liveOtherNeighbours w i)).powersetCard 2

name: AKLT.Defs.pairCoefficient
doc: `d:kernel`: exact type-dependent coefficient, including one-live-neighbour beta-prime.
source:
def pairCoefficient {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) (p : Finset Plane) : ℚ :=
  let straight := wordStraight kernelIncoming w i
  if wordVertex kernelStart w (i.val + 1) ∈ p then
    if (liveOtherNeighbours w i).card = 1 then betaPrimeBound straight else betaBound straight
  else alphaBound straight

name: AKLT.Defs.responsePairType
doc: Pair type is collinear exactly when both sites share a coordinate.
source:
def responsePairType (p : Finset Plane) : PairType := by
  classical
  exact if ∀ x ∈ p, ∀ y ∈ p, x.1 = y.1 ∨ x.2 = y.2 then .B else .C

name: AKLT.Defs.pairShift
doc: `d:kernel`: the actual ambient shift, with maximum over the live pair.
source:
def pairShift (X : PairType) (p : Finset Plane) : ℕ :=
  p.sup fun z => min (latticeDist z kernelStart) (latticeDist z (kernelTarget X))

name: AKLT.Defs.responseKappa
doc: `d:kernel`: coefficients aggregated by pair type and exact shift.

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelWitness
doc: `d:kernel-order`: the exact dyadic witness (not the rational 6/5).

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelRho
doc: `d:kernel-order`: the exact adopted contraction ceiling.
source: def kernelRho : ℚ := 993015 / 10^6

name: AKLT.Defs.witnessKappa
doc: `d:kernel-order`: the finite h-weighted reward at a departure.
source:
def witnessKappa {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : ℚ :=
  ∑ p ∈ responsePairs w i, pairCoefficient w i p * kernelWitness (responsePairType p)

name: AKLT.Defs.firstVisitList
doc: List of lattice first visits in path order.
source:
def firstVisitList {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) : List (Fin n) :=
  (List.finRange n).filter fun i => !wordRevisit kernelStart w i

name: AKLT.Defs.shortOrderLE
doc:
`d:kernel-order`: comparison of short-order scores, with infinity for zero reward
and path-index tie breaking.

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelOrdering
doc: `d:kernel-order`: the fixed cutoff-twelve ordering, independent of theta.
source:
def kernelOrdering {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) : List (Fin n) :=
  let first := firstVisitList w
  if n ≤ 12 then first.mergeSort (shortOrderLE w) else
    first.filter (wordStraight kernelIncoming w) ++ first.filter (fun i => !wordStraight kernelIncoming w i)

name: AKLT.Defs.exposureSum
doc: Exposure sum in a specified order: each reward gets every x up to and including its place.
source:
def exposureSum {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (reward : Fin n → ℚ) : List (Fin n) → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | i :: rest => passageFactor (wordStraight kernelIncoming w i) * (reward i + exposureSum w reward rest)

name: AKLT.Defs.closedContribution
doc: Exact finite h-weighted contribution of one closed trail.
source:
def closedContribution {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) : ℚ :=
  trailBaseWeight kernelStart w * exposureSum w (witnessKappa w) (kernelOrdering w)

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelLengthCoefficient
doc: `d:kernel`: one length's coefficient at a specified type and shift.
source:
def kernelLengthCoefficient (X Y : PairType) (s n : ℕ) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ w : DirectionWord n, if ClosedTrail X w then
    trailBaseWeight kernelStart w * exposureSum w (responseKappa X Y s w) (kernelOrdering w) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.shiftKernel
doc: `d:kernel`: the nonnegative series M_XY,s. ENNReal prevents divergent tsum from becoming zero.
source:
def shiftKernel (X Y : PairType) (s : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' n : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (kernelLengthCoefficient X Y s n : ℝ)

name: AKLT.Defs.shiftedKernel
doc: `d:kernel`: the shifted kernel; finiteness is an explicit conclusion of l:Mtheta.
source:
def shiftedKernel (θ : ℝ) (X Y : PairType) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∑' s : ℕ, shiftKernel X Y s * ENNReal.ofReal (θ ^ (-(s : ℤ)))

name: AKLT.Defs.kernelPartialRow
doc: `h:H3`: a finite-cutoff row sum, with the exact fixed short/long orderings.
source:
def kernelPartialRow (X : PairType) (R : ℕ) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, ∑ w : DirectionWord n,
    if ClosedTrail X w then closedContribution w else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.PositiveVectorBound
doc: `h:H3`: every finite true-trail cutoff, rather than a finite numerical prefix.
source:
def PositiveVectorBound : Prop :=
  ∀ X : PairType, ∀ R : ℕ, kernelPartialRow X R ≤ kernelRho * kernelWitness X

name: AKLT.Defs.Vec3
doc: `d:moment`: three real coordinates; Euclidean geometry is expressed by `dot`.
source: abbrev Vec3 := Fin 3 → ℝ

name: AKLT.Defs.dot
doc: The Euclidean scalar product.
source: def dot (a b : Vec3) : ℝ := ∑ i, a i * b i

name: AKLT.Defs.normSq
doc: The Euclidean squared norm.
source: def normSq (a : Vec3) : ℝ := dot a a

name: AKLT.Defs.UnitVector
doc: `d:moment`: arbitrary unit pins, independent of any frame alphabet.
source: abbrev UnitVector := {a : Vec3 // normSq a = 1}

name: AKLT.Defs.BallVector
doc: Closed unit ball used by the covering and leaf statements.
source: abbrev BallVector := {a : Vec3 // normSq a ≤ 1}

name: AKLT.Defs.goldenRatio
doc: `d:moment`: the golden ratio.
source: def goldenRatio : ℝ := (1 + Real.sqrt 5) / 2

name: AKLT.Defs.icoRadius
doc: `d:moment`: normalization of each icosahedron vertex.
source: def icoRadius : ℝ := Real.sqrt (goldenRatio + 2)

name: AKLT.Defs.IcoLetter
doc: `d:moment`: twelve labels, with the two signs independent.
source: abbrev IcoLetter := Fin 3 × Fin 2 × Fin 2

name: AKLT.Defs.signValue
doc: The two independent sign values.
source: def signValue (j : Fin 2) : ℝ := if j = 0 then 1 else -1

name: AKLT.Defs.icoVector
doc: `d:moment`: the twelve explicit icosahedron vectors, without assuming their moments.
source:
def icoVector (j : IcoLetter) : Vec3 :=
  let a := signValue j.2.1
  let b := signValue j.2.2 * goldenRatio
  let v : Vec3 := if j.1 = 0 then ![0, a, b]
    else if j.1 = 1 then ![a, b, 0] else ![b, 0, a]
  fun k => v k / icoRadius

name: AKLT.Defs.icoSet
doc: `d:moment`: the actual finite set `D`, as a range of its twelve labels.
source: def icoSet : Finset Vec3 := Finset.univ.image icoVector

name: AKLT.Defs.moment
doc: `d:moment`: the fourth-moment functional, defined for arbitrary functions by a finite sum.
source: def moment (f : Vec3 → ℝ) : ℝ := (1 / 12) * ∑ j : IcoLetter, f (icoVector j)

name: AKLT.Defs.Status
doc: `d:domain`: site status; there is no scalar trace mass.
source:
inductive Status where
  | U | D | X
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.SpinLetter
doc:
A common finite support: twelve unit labels and one zero label.
The extra label has weight zero at a U site.
source: abbrev SpinLetter := Option IcoLetter

name: AKLT.Defs.spinVector
doc: The zero atom and the twelve geometric atoms.
source:
def spinVector : SpinLetter → Vec3
  | none => 0
  | some j => icoVector j

name: AKLT.Defs.spinWeight
doc:
`d:moment`: exact weights of `lambda_U` and `lambda_D`.
X sites are omitted from every partition sum.
source:
def spinWeight (s : Status) : SpinLetter → ℝ
  | none => if s = .D then 2 / 5 else 0
  | some _ => if s = .U then 1 / 12 else if s = .D then 1 / 20 else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.siteFunctional
doc: The finite site functional for either active status.
source:
def siteFunctional (s : Status) (f : Vec3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j : SpinLetter, spinWeight s j * f (spinVector j)

name: AKLT.Defs.DegreeFour
doc: A polynomial is admissible when its total degree is at most four.
source: def DegreeFour (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : Prop := p.totalDegree ≤ 4

name: AKLT.Defs.SeparateDegreeFour
doc: `l:moments`: separate degree includes the inserted observable.
source:
def SeparateDegreeFour {ι : Type*} (p : MvPolynomial (ι × Fin 3) ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ x : ι, (∑ k : Fin 3, m (x, k)) ≤ 4

name: AKLT.Defs.productFunctional
doc: A finite product functional, also defined for the empty product of sites.
source:
def productFunctional {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (s : ι → Status)
    (f : (ι → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ n : ι → SpinLetter, (∏ x, spinWeight (s x) (n x)) * f (fun x => spinVector (n x))

name: AKLT.Defs.Representation
doc: `d:reduction`: exactly the two permitted leaf representations.
source:
inductive Representation where
  | reduced | unreduced
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.patternDegree
doc: Internal template degree before passage integration.
source:
def patternDegree (π : PatternData) (x : Plane) : ℕ :=
  (π.bonds.filter fun e => e.1 = x ∨ e.2 = x).card

name: AKLT.Defs.SingleReplacement
doc: `d:reduction`: a tip or corner has a single replacement precisely in these cases.
source:
def SingleReplacement (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (x : Plane) : Prop :=
  patternDegree π x = 1 ∧ (x ∈ templateTips ∨ (r = .reduced ∧ x ∈ templateCorners))

name: AKLT.Defs.reducedSpinSites
doc: `d:reduction`: retained spin sites; deleted positive leaf factors are omitted in both polynomials.
source:
def reducedSpinSites (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) : Finset Plane := by
  classical
  exact π.active.filter fun x => x ∉ templateTips ∧
    (x ∉ templateCorners ∨ (patternDegree π x ≠ 0 ∧ ¬ SingleReplacement π r x))

name: AKLT.Defs.reductionGroups
doc: The eight possible vector groups are indexed by their original corner or tip.
source:
def reductionGroups (π : PatternData) : Finset Plane :=
  (templateCorners ∪ templateTips).filter fun x => 0 < patternDegree π x

name: AKLT.Defs.groupLeader
doc: First original external-slot index at a group.
source:
def groupLeader (x : Plane) : Fin 20 :=
  if x = (1, 1) then 0 else if x = (-1, 1) then 2 else
  if x = (-1, -1) then 4 else if x = (1, -1) then 6 else
  if x = (2, 0) then 8 else if x = (0, 2) then 11 else if x = (-2, 0) then 14 else 17

name: AKLT.Defs.groupSecond
doc: Second slot of a retained corner; the totalized value is unused for singles.
source: def groupSecond (x : Plane) : Fin 20 := ⟨min 19 ((groupLeader x).val + 1), by omega⟩

name: AKLT.Defs.groupIsPair
doc: `d:reduction`: a group is a single or one retained two-slot corner.
source:
def groupIsPair (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (x : Plane) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (x ∈ templateCorners ∧ ¬ SingleReplacement π r x)

name: AKLT.Defs.reductionVectors
doc: `d:reduction`: active vector tokens; unused original slot variables are absent.

name: AKLT.Defs.replacementRadius
doc: `d:reduction`: the exact replacement radii.
source:
def replacementRadius (π : PatternData) (x : Plane) : ℚ :=
  if x ∈ templateTips then 3 / 5 else if π.statusAt x = .U then 1 / 2 else 1 / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.leafNeighbour
doc: The unique internal neighbour of a singly bonded leaf, with a harmless totalization.

name: AKLT.Defs.LocalVariable
doc: Formal variables are internal spin coordinates or remaining vector coordinates.
source: abbrev LocalVariable := (Plane × Fin 3) ⊕ (Fin 20 × Fin 3)

name: AKLT.Defs.formalDot
doc: A formal scalar product in a rational polynomial ring.
source:
def formalDot {σ : Type*} (a b : Fin 3 → σ) : MvPolynomial σ ℚ :=
  ∑ k : Fin 3, MvPolynomial.X (a k) * MvPolynomial.X (b k)

name: AKLT.Defs.rationalMoment
doc: `l:moments`: exact rational degree-four monomial tensor, without real radicals in certificates.
source:
def rationalMoment (m : Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if (∑ i, m i) = 0 then 1 else
  if (∑ i, m i) = 2 ∧ ∃ i, m i = 2 then 1 / 3 else
  if (∑ i, m i) = 4 ∧ ∃ i, m i = 4 then 1 / 5 else
  if (∑ i, m i) = 4 ∧ (∀ i, Even (m i)) then 1 / 15 else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.rationalStatusMoment
doc: `d:moment`: D has unit constant moment and 3/5 of each positive-degree tensor.
source:
def rationalStatusMoment (s : Status) (m : Fin 3 → ℕ) : ℚ :=
  if s = .D ∧ (∑ i, m i) ≠ 0 then (3 / 5) * rationalMoment m else rationalMoment m

name: AKLT.Defs.contractSpins
doc: Finite moment contraction of the internal spin variables, retaining the vector monomials.
source:
def contractSpins (V : Finset Plane) (status : Plane → Status)
    (p : MvPolynomial LocalVariable ℚ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ :=
  ∑ m ∈ p.support,
    MvPolynomial.monomial (Finsupp.comapDomain Sum.inr m (by
      intro a _ b _ h
      exact Sum.inr.inj h))
      (p.coeff m * ∏ x ∈ V, rationalStatusMoment (status x) (fun k => m (.inl (x, k))))

name: AKLT.Defs.reducedIntegrand
doc:
`d:reduction`: actual rational polynomial before internal moment contraction.
Singleton factors use the exact leaf radii; retained corners keep both original slots.
source:
def reducedIntegrand (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (next : Bool) :
    MvPolynomial LocalVariable ℚ :=
  let V := reducedSpinSites π r
  (∏ e ∈ π.bonds,
    if e.1 ∈ V ∧ e.2 ∈ V ∧
      ¬ (next ∧ ({e.1, e.2} : Finset Plane) = {(0, 0), π.outgoing.step}) then
      1 + formalDot (fun k => .inl (e.1, k)) (fun k => .inl (e.2, k)) else 1) *
  (∏ x ∈ reductionGroups π,
    if groupIsPair π r x then
      (1 + formalDot (fun k => .inl (x, k)) (fun k => .inr (groupLeader x, k))) *
      (1 + formalDot (fun k => .inl (x, k)) (fun k => .inr (groupSecond x, k)))
    else 1 + MvPolynomial.C (replacementRadius π x) *
      formalDot (fun k => .inl (leafNeighbour π x, k)) (fun k => .inr (groupLeader x, k)))

name: AKLT.Defs.reducedPolynomial
doc: `d:reduction`: the reconstructed current and next polynomials, not supplied certificate matrices.
source:
def reducedPolynomial (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (next : Bool) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ :=
  contractSpins (reducedSpinSites π r)
    (fun x => if next ∧ x = (0, 0) then .D else π.statusAt x) (reducedIntegrand π r next)

name: AKLT.Defs.reducedDifference
doc: `d:reduction`: the difference polynomial at an exact rational threshold.

name: AKLT.Defs.VectorAffine
doc: `d:Pauli`: affine in each entire vector, rather than separately in each scalar coordinate.
source:
def VectorAffine (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ j : Fin 20, (∑ k : Fin 3, m (j, k)) ≤ 1

name: AKLT.Defs.invertPolynomial
doc: `d:Pauli`: inversion of selected vector tokens.
source:
def invertPolynomial (I : Finset (Fin 20)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom MvPolynomial.C (fun v =>
    (if v.1 ∈ I then -1 else 1) * MvPolynomial.X v) p

name: AKLT.Defs.GroupInversion
doc: `d:reduction`: an allowed inversion is a union of whole groups.

name: AKLT.Defs.pauliExponent
doc: Monomial exponent for the unique vector-affine Pauli expansion.

name: AKLT.Defs.pauliOperator
doc: `d:Pauli`: concrete tensor-basis operator, with no tensor-product library choices.
source:
def pauliOperator (J : Finset (Fin 20)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) :
    Matrix (J → Fin 2) (J → Fin 2) ℂ :=
  fun σ τ => ∑ a : J → Fin 4,
    (p.coeff (pauliExponent J a) : ℂ) * ∏ j : J, pauli (a j) (σ j) (τ j)

name: AKLT.Defs.ratComplexMul
doc: Rational complex arithmetic used for exact sector reconstruction.
source: def ratComplexMul (a b : ℚ × ℚ) : ℚ × ℚ := (a.1 * b.1 - a.2 * b.2, a.1 * b.2 + a.2 * b.1)

name: AKLT.Defs.rationalPauli
doc: Rational real/imaginary Pauli entries.
source:
def rationalPauli (a : Fin 4) (i j : Fin 2) : ℚ × ℚ :=
  if a = 0 then (if i = j then 1 else 0, 0) else
  if a = 1 then (if i ≠ j then 1 else 0, 0) else
  if a = 2 then (0, if i = j then 0 else if i = 0 then -1 else 1) else
    (if i ≠ j then 0 else if i = 0 then 1 else -1, 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.rationalOperatorEntry
doc: Exact rational real part of the operator entry, reconstructed from polynomial coefficients.
source:
def rationalOperatorEntry (J : Finset (Fin 20)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ)
    (σ τ : J → Fin 2) : ℚ :=
  ∑ a : J → Fin 4, p.coeff (pauliExponent J a) *
    (((Finset.univ : Finset J).toList.map fun j => rationalPauli (a j) (σ j) (τ j)).foldl
      ratComplexMul (1, 0)).1

name: AKLT.Defs.ExchangeSigns
doc: `d:exchange`: one sign for each retained D pair; unused signs are immaterial.
source: abbrev ExchangeSigns (π : PatternData) := reductionGroups π → Bool

name: AKLT.Defs.GroupBasis
doc: The actual type of a group basis: two singles, three symmetric, or one exterior vector.

name: AKLT.Defs.ExchangeBasis
doc: `d:exchange`: the integer-coordinate tensor-sector basis.
source:
abbrev ExchangeBasis (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π) :=
  (x : reductionGroups π) → GroupBasis π r ε x

name: AKLT.Defs.exchangeWeight
doc: Magnetic weight of an integer-coordinate sector vector.

name: AKLT.Defs.centralWeight
doc: `d:exchange`: central weight is determined by the number of singles.
source:
def centralWeight (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) : ℚ :=
  if Even ((reductionGroups π).filter fun x => !groupIsPair π r x).card then 0 else 1 / 2

name: AKLT.Defs.CentralBasis
doc: `d:exchange`: actual central-weight basis, with its unnormalized integer coordinates.
source:
abbrev CentralBasis (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π) :=
  {b : ExchangeBasis π r ε // exchangeWeight π r ε b = centralWeight π r}

name: AKLT.Defs.exchangeBasisVector
doc: Integer coefficients of each supported exchange-sector basis vector in the full tensor basis.
source:
def exchangeBasisVector (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (b : ExchangeBasis π r ε) (σ : reductionVectors π r → Fin 2) : ℤ :=
  ∏ x : reductionGroups π,
    let i := σ ⟨groupLeader x.val, by
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; refine ⟨x.val, x.property, ?_⟩
      split <;> simp⟩
    if h : groupIsPair π r x.val = true then
      let j := σ ⟨groupSecond x.val, by
        apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; exact ⟨x.val, x.property, by simp [h]⟩⟩
      if π.statusAt x.val = .D ∧ ε x = false then
        if i = 0 ∧ j = 1 then 1 else if i = 1 ∧ j = 0 then -1 else 0
      else if (b x).val = 0 then if i = 0 ∧ j = 0 then 1 else 0
      else if (b x).val = 1 then if i ≠ j then 1 else 0
      else if i = 1 ∧ j = 1 then 1 else 0
    else if i.val = (b x).val then 1 else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.rationalSectorEntry
doc: Exact rational Hermitian-form entry in the unnormalized central-sector basis.
source:
def rationalSectorEntry (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) (a b : CentralBasis π r ε) : ℚ :=
  ∑ σ, ∑ τ, (exchangeBasisVector π r ε a.val σ : ℚ) *
    rationalOperatorEntry (reductionVectors π r) p σ τ * (exchangeBasisVector π r ε b.val τ : ℚ)

name: AKLT.Defs.ClearsDenominator
doc: `l:integercheck`: a justified denominator clears 3D0 current and 5D0 next coefficients.

name: AKLT.Defs.integerSectorMatrix
doc: `l:integercheck`: reconstructed integer A or A', never an arbitrary stored matrix.
source:
def integerSectorMatrix (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (I : Finset (Fin 20)) (D₀ : ℕ) (next : Bool) :
    Matrix (CentralBasis π r ε) (CentralBasis π r ε) ℤ :=
  fun a b => ⌊(if next then 5 else 3) * (D₀ : ℚ) * rationalSectorEntry π r ε
    (invertPolynomial I (reducedPolynomial π r next)) a b⌋

name: AKLT.Defs.thresholdSectorMatrix
doc: `l:integercheck`: the exact threshold sector matrix 5q A - 3p A'.
source:
def thresholdSectorMatrix (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (I : Finset (Fin 20)) (D₀ p q : ℕ) :
    Matrix (CentralBasis π r ε) (CentralBasis π r ε) ℤ :=
  (5 * (q : ℤ)) • integerSectorMatrix π r ε I D₀ false -
    (3 * (p : ℤ)) • integerSectorMatrix π r ε I D₀ true

name: AKLT.Defs.gramResidual
doc: `l:gram-residual`: residual with independent positive integer scales.
source:
def gramResidual {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (M L : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (g d S : ℕ) : Matrix ι ι ℤ :=
  ((d : ℤ) * (S : ℤ)^2) • M - (g : ℤ) • (L * L.transpose)

name: AKLT.Defs.GramResidualRows
doc: `l:gram-residual`: exact division-free row conditions, including positive diagonal.
source:
def GramResidualRows {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    (M L : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (g d S : ℕ) : Prop :=
  0 < g ∧ 0 < d ∧ 0 < S ∧
  ∀ i, 0 < gramResidual M L g d S i i ∧
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, |gramResidual M L g d S i j|) < gramResidual M L g d S i i

name: AKLT.Defs.supportSpins
doc: Spin coordinates on an explicitly finite support, zero only at omitted sites.
source:
def supportSpins (V : Finset Plane) (n : V → SpinLetter) (x : Plane) : Vec3 :=
  if h : x ∈ V then spinVector (n ⟨x, h⟩) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.withoutPassageFunctional
doc: `l:Iw`: deletion of the passage site and its factors, keeping all covered slots.
source:
def withoutPassageFunctional (π : PatternData) (m : Fin 20 → UnitVector)
    (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let V := π.active.erase (0, 0)
  ∑ n : V → SpinLetter,
    (∏ x : V, spinWeight (π.statusAt x.val) (n x)) * f (supportSpins V n) *
    (∏ e ∈ π.bonds, if e.1 = (0, 0) ∨ e.2 = (0, 0) then 1
      else 1 + dot (supportSpins V n e.1) (supportSpins V n e.2)) *
    ∏ j : Fin 20, if π.statusAt (externalSlot j).1 = .X then 1 else
      1 + dot (m j).val (supportSpins V n (externalSlot j).1)

name: AKLT.Defs.originalPatternPolynomial
doc: The original rational pattern polynomial, before any leaf deletion.

name: AKLT.Defs.coveredSiteField
doc: `l:leaf`: the local product of every covered slot at one boundary site.
source:
def coveredSiteField (m : Fin 20 → UnitVector) (x : Plane) (n : Vec3) : ℝ :=
  ∏ j : Fin 20, if (externalSlot j).1 = x then 1 + dot (m j).val n else 1

name: AKLT.Defs.SupportedVectors
doc: A polynomial uses no vector tokens outside its specified finite tensor product.
source:
def SupportedVectors (J : Finset (Fin 20)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ m ∈ p.support, ∀ j : Fin 20, j ∉ J → ∀ k : Fin 3, m (j, k) = 0

name: AKLT.Defs.complexSectorMatrix
doc: The integer-coordinate complex Hermitian form, before any denominator rounding.
source:
def complexSectorMatrix (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 20 × Fin 3) ℚ) :
    Matrix (CentralBasis π r ε) (CentralBasis π r ε) ℂ :=
  fun a b => ∑ σ, ∑ τ,
    (exchangeBasisVector π r ε a.val σ : ℂ) * pauliOperator (reductionVectors π r) p σ τ *
      (exchangeBasisVector π r ε b.val τ : ℂ)

name: AKLT.Defs.indexedSectorMatrix
doc:
Reindex by an explicit basis bijection, so certificate data choose their concrete
finite ordering without relying on a noncomputable enumeration.
source:
def indexedSectorMatrix (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (ε : ExchangeSigns π)
    (I : Finset (Fin 20)) (D₀ p q : ℕ) {t : ℕ} (index : Fin t ≃ CentralBasis π r ε) :
    Matrix (Fin t) (Fin t) ℤ :=
  (thresholdSectorMatrix π r ε I D₀ p q).submatrix index index

name: AKLT.Defs.leaderToken
doc: The single tensor slot of any group.
source:
def leaderToken (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (x : reductionGroups π) : reductionVectors π r :=
  ⟨groupLeader x.val, by
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨x.val, x.property, ?_⟩
    split <;> simp⟩

name: AKLT.Defs.secondToken
doc: The second token of a retained pair.
source:
def secondToken (π : PatternData) (r : Representation) (x : reductionGroups π)
    (h : groupIsPair π r x.val = true) : reductionVectors π r :=
  ⟨groupSecond x.val, by
    apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨x.val, x.property, by simp [h]⟩⟩

name: AKLT.Defs.exchangeOperator
doc: Exchange of two tensor factors, as an actual linear map on Hilbert coordinates.

name: AKLT.Defs.symmetricPairProjection
doc: Symmetric-pair orthogonal projection `(I+exchange)/2`.

name: AKLT.Defs.tensorPowerMatrix
doc: Tensor power of a two-dimensional matrix in the same tensor basis as all operators.
source:
def tensorPowerMatrix (J : Finset (Fin 20)) (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
    Matrix (J → Fin 2) (J → Fin 2) ℂ := fun σ τ => ∏ j : J, g (σ j) (τ j)

name: AKLT.Defs.leadingMinor
doc: Leading principal minor, including order zero, in exact integer arithmetic.

name: AKLT.Defs.bareissState
doc: `l:integercheck`: optional Bareiss state, retaining the previous pivot separately.
source:
def bareissState {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) : ℕ → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ × ℤ
  | 0 => (M, 1)
  | j + 1 =>
    let old := bareissState M j
    if h : j < n then
      let a : Fin n := ⟨j, h⟩
      (fun i l => if j < i.val ∧ j < l.val then
        (old.1 a a * old.1 i l - old.1 i a * old.1 a l) / old.2 else old.1 i l,
        old.1 a a)
    else old

name: AKLT.Defs.bareissPivot
doc: The j-th optional Bareiss pivot.
source:
def bareissPivot {n : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ) (j : ℕ) : ℤ :=
  if h : j < n then (bareissState M j).1 ⟨j, h⟩ ⟨j, h⟩ else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.templateSites
doc: `d:pattern`: the thirteen sites in the radius-two taxicab template.
source: def templateSites : Finset Plane := (square (0, 0) 2).filter fun z => latticeDist z (0, 0) ≤ 2

name: AKLT.Defs.templateTips
doc: `d:pattern`: the four covering tips.
source: def templateTips : Finset Plane := {(2, 0), (0, 2), (-2, 0), (0, -2)}

name: AKLT.Defs.templateCorners
doc: `d:pattern`: the four corners, each with both external slots.
source: def templateCorners : Finset Plane := {(1, 1), (-1, 1), (-1, -1), (1, -1)}

name: AKLT.Defs.externalSlot
doc: `d:pattern`: all twenty slots, with a fixed transparent order.

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData
doc: `d:pattern`: finite raw data; coveredness is a separate predicate.
source:
structure PatternData where
  outgoing : Compass
  status : templateSites → Status
  kept : templateSites → Finset Compass

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.statusAt
doc: Template status, with removed values outside its finite support.
source:
def PatternData.statusAt (π : PatternData) (x : Plane) : Status :=
  if h : x ∈ templateSites then π.status ⟨x, h⟩ else .X

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.keptAt
doc: Kept half-bonds of a template site, expressed in absolute directions.
source:
def PatternData.keptAt (π : PatternData) (x : Plane) : Finset Plane :=
  if h : x ∈ templateSites then (π.kept ⟨x, h⟩).image (fun d => x + d.step) else ∅

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.Covered
doc: `d:pattern`: the corrected covered rules, including the covering-tip exception.
source:
def PatternData.Covered (π : PatternData) : Prop :=
  π.outgoing ≠ .south ∧ π.statusAt (0, 0) = .U ∧
  π.keptAt (0, 0) = {(1, 0), (0, 1), (-1, 0)} ∧
  (π.statusAt (0, -1) = .X ∨ (π.statusAt (0, -1) = .D ∧
    (π.keptAt (0, -1)).card = 2 ∧ (0, 0) ∉ π.keptAt (0, -1))) ∧
  (∀ d ∈ ({Compass.east, .north, .west} : Finset Compass),
    π.statusAt d.step = .U ∨ π.statusAt d.step = .X ∨
      (π.statusAt d.step = .D ∧ (π.keptAt d.step).card = 2 ∧ (0, 0) ∈ π.keptAt d.step)) ∧
  π.statusAt π.outgoing.step ≠ .X ∧
  (∀ x ∈ templateCorners, π.statusAt x = .U ∨ π.statusAt x = .X ∨
    (π.statusAt x = .D ∧ (π.keptAt x).card = 2)) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ templateSites, x ≠ (0, 0) → x ∉ templateTips → π.statusAt x = .U →
    π.keptAt x = neighbours x) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ templateTips, π.statusAt x = .U) ∧
  ∀ x ∈ templateSites \ templateTips, ∀ y ∈ templateSites \ templateTips,
    π.statusAt x ≠ .X → π.statusAt y ≠ .X → Adjacent x y →
      (y ∈ π.keptAt x ↔ x ∈ π.keptAt y)

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.bonds
doc: Present template bonds ignore any global kept set at a covering tip.
source:
def PatternData.bonds (π : PatternData) : Finset (Plane × Plane) :=
  (internalBonds templateSites).filter fun e =>
    π.statusAt e.1 ≠ .X ∧ π.statusAt e.2 ≠ .X ∧
    (e.1 ∈ templateTips ∨ e.2 ∈ π.keptAt e.1) ∧
    (e.2 ∈ templateTips ∨ e.1 ∈ π.keptAt e.2)

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.active
doc: Active sites of a covered template.
source:
def PatternData.active (π : PatternData) : Finset Plane :=
  templateSites.filter fun x => π.statusAt x ≠ .X

name: AKLT.Defs.PatternData.spins
doc: Finite template spin coordinates.
source:
def PatternData.spins (π : PatternData) (n : (x : π.active) → SpinLetter) (x : Plane) : Vec3 :=
  if h : x ∈ π.active then spinVector (n ⟨x, h⟩) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.patternFunctional
doc:
`d:pattern`: finite current/next functional. Every external slot is retained.
For next, the passage law changes to D and its out-bond is dropped.
source:
def patternFunctional (π : PatternData) (next : Bool) (m : Fin 20 → UnitVector)
    (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n : (x : π.active) → SpinLetter,
    (∏ x : π.active,
      spinWeight (if next ∧ x.val = (0, 0) then .D else π.statusAt x.val) (n x)) *
    f (π.spins n) *
    (∏ e ∈ π.bonds,
      if next ∧ ({e.1, e.2} : Finset Plane) = {(0, 0), π.outgoing.step} then 1
      else 1 + dot (π.spins n e.1) (π.spins n e.2)) *
    ∏ j : Fin 20,
      if π.statusAt (externalSlot j).1 = .X then 1
      else 1 + dot (m j).val (π.spins n (externalSlot j).1)

name: AKLT.Defs.patternCurrent
doc: `d:pattern`: current covered local partition polynomial.
source:
def patternCurrent (π : PatternData) (m : Fin 20 → UnitVector) : ℝ :=
  patternFunctional π false m (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.patternNext
doc: `d:pattern`: next covered local partition polynomial.
source:
def patternNext (π : PatternData) (m : Fin 20 → UnitVector) : ℝ :=
  patternFunctional π true m (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.LocalPatternBound
doc: `h:H1`: pointwise inequalities; no optimality or minimizer is asserted.
source:
def LocalPatternBound (cs ct : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 < cs ∧ cs ≤ 1 ∧ 0 < ct ∧ ct ≤ 1 ∧
  ∀ π : PatternData, π.Covered → ∀ m : Fin 20 → UnitVector,
    (if π.outgoing = .north then cs else ct) * patternNext π m ≤ patternCurrent π m

name: AKLT.Defs.PinAssignment
doc: `d:pinmodel`: independent unit pins on each original leg, even at a shared outside endpoint.
source: abbrev PinAssignment (G : Finset Plane) := (e : originalLegs G) → UnitVector

name: AKLT.Defs.extendIcoSpins
doc: Extension by zero is only an indexing convention at omitted sites.
source:
def extendIcoSpins {V : Finset Plane} (n : (x : V) → IcoLetter) (x : Plane) : Vec3 :=
  if h : x ∈ V then icoVector (n ⟨x, h⟩) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.pinnedSum
doc: `d:pinmodel`: partition sum with original pins and no new factors into removed sites.
source:
def pinnedSum (G Y : Finset Plane) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n : (↥(G \ Y) → IcoLetter),
    (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ (G \ Y).card * f (extendIcoSpins n) *
    (∏ e ∈ internalBonds (G \ Y), (1 + dot (extendIcoSpins n e.1) (extendIcoSpins n e.2))) *
    ∏ e : originalLegs G,
      if e.val.1 ∈ G \ Y then 1 + dot (τ e).val (extendIcoSpins n e.val.1) else 1

name: AKLT.Defs.freeSum
doc: `d:pinmodel`: free partition sum, omitting all original-leg factors.
source:
def freeSum (G Y : Finset Plane) (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ n : (↥(G \ Y) → IcoLetter),
    (1 / 12 : ℝ) ^ (G \ Y).card * f (extendIcoSpins n) *
    ∏ e ∈ internalBonds (G \ Y), (1 + dot (extendIcoSpins n e.1) (extendIcoSpins n e.2))

name: AKLT.Defs.pinnedExpectation
doc: `d:pinmodel`: normalized pinned expectation.
source:
def pinnedExpectation (G Y : Finset Plane) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ := pinnedSum G Y τ f / pinnedSum G Y τ (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.freeExpectation
doc: `d:pinmodel`: normalized free expectation.
source:
def freeExpectation (G Y : Finset Plane) (f : (Plane → Vec3) → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  freeSum G Y f / freeSum G Y (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.partitionRatio
doc: `d:pinmodel`: pinned/free partition ratio, always relative to the original G.
source:
def partitionRatio (G Y : Finset Plane) (τ : PinAssignment G) : ℝ :=
  pinnedSum G Y τ (fun _ => 1) / freeSum G Y (fun _ => 1)

name: AKLT.Defs.ResponseProperty
doc:
`h:P`: all original volumes, independent unit pins, permitted removals and distance-two pairs.
Distances are to the original protected layer, and infinity has decay zero.
source:
def ResponseProperty (A θ : ℝ) : Prop :=
  2 ≤ A ∧ 0 < θ ∧ θ < 1 ∧
  ∀ G : Finset Plane, ∀ τ : PinAssignment G, ∀ Y : Finset Plane,
    Y ⊆ G \ protectedSites G → ∀ u v : Plane,
    u ∈ G \ Y → v ∈ G \ Y → latticeDist u v = 2 →
    (∃ c ∈ Y, Adjacent u c ∧ Adjacent v c) →
    |pinnedExpectation G Y τ (fun n => dot (n u) (n v)) -
      freeExpectation G Y (fun n => dot (n u) (n v))| ≤
      A * decay θ (min (setDistance latticeDist u (↑(protectedSites G) : Set Plane))
        (setDistance latticeDist v (↑(protectedSites G) : Set Plane)))

name: AKLT.Defs.cutCost
doc: `t:cutMOS`: the exact removal-cost constant, including the retained seed.

name: AKLT.Defs.cutProbability
doc: `t:cutMOS`: the displayed common minorization probability.
source: def cutProbability (A θ : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp (-2 * cutCost A θ)

name: AKLT.Defs.BinaryForm
doc: `d:poly`: ordinary monomial coefficients of homogeneous binary forms of degree d.
source: abbrev BinaryForm (d : ℕ) := Fin (d + 1) → ℂ

name: AKLT.Defs.binaryNormSq
doc: `d:poly`: the prescribed monomial norm, including inverse binomial weights.
source:
def binaryNormSq (d : ℕ) (p : BinaryForm d) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, Complex.normSq (p j) / (Nat.choose d j.val : ℝ)

name: AKLT.Defs.binaryEval
doc: Evaluation of a binary form in its two spinor coordinates.
source:
def binaryEval (d : ℕ) (p : BinaryForm d) (z : Spinor) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j, p j * z 0 ^ (d - j.val) * z 1 ^ j.val

name: AKLT.Defs.binaryPolynomial
doc: The actual polynomial represented by the finite coefficient array.

name: AKLT.Defs.binaryActionPolynomial
doc: `d:poly`: pullback by the inverse matrix, before extracting homogeneous coefficients.
source:
def binaryActionPolynomial (d : ℕ) (g : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ)
    (p : BinaryForm d) : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ :=
  MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom MvPolynomial.C
    (fun i => ∑ j, MvPolynomial.C (g⁻¹ i j) * MvPolynomial.X j) (binaryPolynomial d p)

name: AKLT.Defs.physicalEval
doc:
`d:poly`: evaluate a frozen physical vector in ordinary monomial coordinates.
The square-root binomial factors undo the frozen orthonormal coordinate conversion.
source:
def physicalEval {L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size} (ψ : AKLT.Challenge.Hilbert L N)
    (z : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N → Spinor) : ℂ :=
  ∑ σ : AKLT.Challenge.Configuration L N, ψ σ *
    ∏ x, (Real.sqrt (Nat.choose 4 (σ x).val : ℝ) : ℂ) *
      z x 0 ^ (4 - (σ x).val) * z x 1 ^ (σ x).val

name: AKLT.Defs.hamiltonian
doc: `d:model`: no second Hamiltonian is defined; this is the frozen H.
source: abbrev hamiltonian := AKLT.Challenge.H

name: AKLT.Defs.vbs
doc: `d:model`: no second VBS state is defined; this is the frozen B.
source: abbrev vbs := AKLT.Challenge.B

name: AKLT.Defs.Weight
doc: Finite weights. Normalization and positivity are conclusions, never hidden assumptions.
source: abbrev Weight (Ω : Type*) := Ω → ℝ

name: AKLT.Defs.normalize
doc: Normalize a finite weight by its actual partition sum.
source:
def normalize {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (w : Weight Ω) : Weight Ω :=
  fun x => w x / ∑ y, w y

name: AKLT.Defs.PositiveProbability
doc: A positive probability on an explicitly finite state space.
source:
def PositiveProbability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, 0 < p x) ∧ ∑ x, p x = 1

name: AKLT.Defs.Probability
doc: An arbitrary finite probability, allowing zero atoms.
source:
def Probability {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, 0 ≤ p x) ∧ ∑ x, p x = 1

name: AKLT.Defs.expectation
doc: Finite real expectation.
source:
def expectation {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, p x * f x

name: AKLT.Defs.totalVariation
doc: `d:moment`: total variation with the factor one half.
source:
def totalVariation {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p q : Weight Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2) * ∑ x, |p x - q x|

name: AKLT.Defs.complexMean
doc: Finite complex expectation.
source:
def complexMean {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) (f : Ω → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ x, (p x : ℂ) * f x

name: AKLT.Defs.variance
doc: `d:framemodel`: complex variance, a real nonnegative quadratic form for probabilities.
source:
def variance {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (p : Weight Ω) (f : Ω → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ x, p x * Complex.normSq (f x - complexMean p f)

name: AKLT.Defs.AgreeOutside
doc: Agreement on the complement of a physical block.
source:
def AgreeOutside {ι : Type*} {S : ι → Type*} (U : Finset ι)
    (σ τ : (x : ι) → S x) : Prop := ∀ x, x ∉ U → σ x = τ x

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionalExpectation
doc: `d:framemodel`: conditioning off a block, given by its finite fibre quotient.
source:
def conditionalExpectation {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    [∀ x, Fintype (S x)] (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) (U : Finset ι)
    (f : ((x : ι) → S x) → ℂ) (σ : (x : ι) → S x) : ℂ := by
  classical
  exact (∑ τ, if AgreeOutside U σ τ then (p τ : ℂ) * f τ else 0) /
    (∑ τ, if AgreeOutside U σ τ then (p τ : ℂ) else 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionalVariance
doc:
`d:framemodel`: the pointwise conditional variance E_U |f-E_U f|^2,
with the same explicit fibre denominator as the conditional expectation.
source:
def conditionalVariance {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    [∀ x, Fintype (S x)] (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) (U : Finset ι)
    (f : ((x : ι) → S x) → ℂ) (σ : (x : ι) → S x) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact (∑ τ, if AgreeOutside U σ τ then
    p τ * Complex.normSq (f τ - conditionalExpectation p U f τ) else 0) /
      (∑ τ, if AgreeOutside U σ τ then p τ else 0)

name: AKLT.Defs.blockDirichlet
doc: The integrated conditional variance in a physical block.
source:
def blockDirichlet {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    [∀ x, Fintype (S x)] (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) (U : Finset ι)
    (f : ((x : ι) → S x) → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ σ, p σ * Complex.normSq (f σ - conditionalExpectation p U f σ)

name: AKLT.Defs.dirichlet
doc: `d:framemodel`: rate one per physical site, with no volume normalization.
source:
def dirichlet {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ x, Fintype (S x)]
    (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) (f : ((x : ι) → S x) → ℂ) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ x, blockDirichlet p {x} f

name: AKLT.Defs.PoincareLower
doc: `d:framemodel`: a gap lower bound as a Poincare inequality, including singletons.
source:
def PoincareLower {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ x, Fintype (S x)]
    (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) (g : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ f, g * variance p f ≤ dirichlet p f

name: AKLT.Defs.heatBathGap
doc: The infimum definition of the heat-bath gap, with infinity for a one-point space.
source:
def heatBathGap {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ι → Type*} [∀ x, Fintype (S x)]
    (p : Weight ((x : ι) → S x)) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ⨅ f : {f : ((x : ι) → S x) → ℂ // 0 < variance p f},
    ENNReal.ofReal (dirichlet p f.val / variance p f.val)

name: AKLT.Defs.hamming
doc: `d:moment`: Hamming distance counts actual sites.
source:
def hamming {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {S : ι → Type*}
    (σ τ : (x : ι) → S x) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact (Finset.univ.filter fun x => σ x ≠ τ x).card

name: AKLT.Defs.Coupling
doc: A finite coupling specified by nonnegative entries and both full marginals.
source:
structure Coupling {Ω Ξ : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [Fintype Ξ]
    (p : Weight Ω) (q : Weight Ξ) where
  mass : Ω → Ξ → ℝ
  nonnegative : ∀ x y, 0 ≤ mass x y
  first_marginal : ∀ x, ∑ y, mass x y = p x
  second_marginal : ∀ y, ∑ x, mass x y = q y

name: AKLT.Defs.torusNeighbours
doc: `p:toruskernel`: four actual neighbours on the frozen torus, also at period three.
source:
def torusNeighbours {L N : Size} (x : Site L N) : Finset (Site L N) :=
  {(x.1 + 1, x.2), (x.1 - 1, x.2), (x.1, x.2 + 1), (x.1, x.2 - 1)}

name: AKLT.Defs.polynomialState
doc: Convert an ordinary physical polynomial to the frozen orthonormal coordinates.

name: AKLT.Defs.reorientedB
doc: `p:toruskernel`: reversing any selected edges changes only the corresponding singlet signs.
source:
def reorientedB (L N : Size) (ε : Bond L N → Bool) : Hilbert L N :=
  polynomialState (∏ e : Bond L N, if ε e then singlet e else -singlet e)

name: AKLT.Defs.StarHilbert
doc: `l:star`: the five-site tensor coordinates, using the frozen spin-two matrices.
source: abbrev StarHilbert := EuclideanSpace ℂ (Fin 5 → Fin 5)

name: AKLT.Defs.starAtSite
doc: A frozen spin matrix lifted to one factor of the five-site star.
source:
def starAtSite (A : Matrix (Fin 5) (Fin 5) ℂ) (x : Fin 5) : Module.End ℂ StarHilbert :=
  Matrix.toEuclideanLin fun σ τ => if ∀ y, y ≠ x → σ y = τ y then A (σ x) (τ x) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.starCasimir
doc: The frozen Casimir formula on the central factor and leaf j+1.
source:
def starCasimir (j : Fin 4) : Module.End ℂ StarHilbert :=
  let y : Fin 5 := ⟨j.val + 1, by omega⟩
  let Z := starAtSite spinZ 0 + starAtSite spinZ y
  let U := starAtSite spinPlus 0 + starAtSite spinPlus y
  let D := starAtSite spinMinus 0 + starAtSite spinMinus y
  Z * Z + (1 / 2 : ℂ) • (U * D + D * U)

name: AKLT.Defs.starHamiltonian
doc: `l:star`: the actual sum of four total-spin-four orthogonal projectors.
source:
def starHamiltonian : Module.End ℂ StarHilbert :=
  ∑ j : Fin 4, (Module.End.eigenspace (starCasimir j) 20).starProjection.toLinearMap

name: AKLT.Defs.starGap
doc: `l:star`: the smallest positive eigenvalue, whose existence and positivity are stated explicitly.
source: def starGap : ℝ := sInf {μ : ℝ | 0 < μ ∧ starHamiltonian.HasEigenvalue (μ : ℂ)}

name: AKLT.Defs.siteHamiltonian
doc: `l:star`: H_x uses exactly the incident frozen projectors.
source:
def siteHamiltonian {L N : Size} (x : Site L N) : Module.End ℂ (Hilbert L N) :=
  ∑ e : Bond L N, if x ∈ bondSites e then P e else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.EventualMain
doc: Eventual ground-space and spectral-gap conclusion, with the actual frozen H and B.
source:
def EventualMain : Prop :=
  ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ L₀ : ℕ, 3 ≤ L₀ ∧
    ∀ L N : Size, L₀ ≤ L.val → L₀ ≤ N.val →
      LinearMap.ker (H L N) = Submodule.span ℂ {B L N} ∧
      ∀ μ : ℝ, μ ≠ 0 → (H L N).HasEigenvalue (μ : ℂ) → c ≤ μ

name: AKLT.Defs.logarithmicMean
doc: `l:log-mean-bounds`: logarithmic mean, with its continuous diagonal value.
source: def logarithmicMean (x y : ℝ) : ℝ := if x = y then x else (x - y) / (Real.log x - Real.log y)

name: AKLT.Defs.reciprocalLogMean
doc: `l:log-mean-bounds`: reciprocal logarithmic mean against one, including f(1)=1.
source: def reciprocalLogMean (s : ℝ) : ℝ := (logarithmicMean s 1)⁻¹

name: AKLT.Defs.logMeanLower
doc: The eight-term exact lower enclosure.

name: AKLT.Defs.logMeanUpper
doc: The exact rational remainder in the upper enclosure.

name: AKLT.Defs.removeSite
doc: `d:ratios`: removal of the departure site, with every original pin unchanged.
source:
def removeSite {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (y : Plane) : Network G :=
  { D with status := Function.update D.status y .X }

name: AKLT.Defs.stepRatio
doc: `d:ratios`: actual step partition quotient in the mass-free convention.
source:
def stepRatio {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (pinned : Bool) (y o : Plane) : ℝ := traceRatio D τ pinned [y, o]

name: AKLT.Defs.removedPairMean
doc: A pair expectation in the departure-deleted network.

name: AKLT.Defs.responseI
doc: `d:ratios`: I for the three-present-neighbour case.
source:
def responseI {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (pinned : Bool) (y o f g : Plane) : ℝ :=
  1 + (removedPairMean D τ pinned y f g + removedPairMean D τ pinned y f o +
    removedPairMean D τ pinned y g o) / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.responseJ
doc: `d:ratios`: J for the three-present-neighbour case.
source:
def responseJ {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (τ : PinAssignment G)
    (pinned : Bool) (y f g : Plane) : ℝ := 1 + removedPairMean D τ pinned y f g / 5

name: AKLT.Defs.responseBeta
doc: `l:response`: the actual beta coefficient obtained by the logarithmic-mean identity.

name: AKLT.Defs.responseAlpha
doc: `l:response`: the actual alpha coefficient, without an optimized constant hypothesis.

name: AKLT.Defs.responseBetaPrime
doc: `l:response`: beta-prime for exactly two present neighbours.

name: AKLT.Defs.normalizeRotation
doc: Rotation sending the canonical incoming north direction to the actual direction.

name: AKLT.Defs.CoveredDeparture
doc:
`l:local`, `l:response-typed`: exact normalized non-tip matching to a covered pattern.
Covering tips are intentionally not constrained by any global tip kept set.
source:
def CoveredDeparture {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (y : Plane) (incoming outgoing : Compass) : Prop :=
  ∃ π : PatternData, π.Covered ∧ normalizeRotation incoming π.outgoing.step = outgoing.step ∧
    ∀ z ∈ templateSites \ templateTips,
      π.statusAt z = D.status (y + normalizeRotation incoming z) ∧
      (π.statusAt z ≠ .X →
        (π.keptAt z).image (fun t => y + normalizeRotation incoming t) =
          D.kept (y + normalizeRotation incoming z))

name: AKLT.Defs.inducedBoundary
doc: The smaller-volume boundary induced by a larger-volume configuration and its exterior.

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionalPlaneLaw
doc: `l:planeenergy`: the conditional V law inside W, with both sides indexed by actual V configurations.
source:
def conditionalPlaneLaw (κ : Plane → Fin 3) (W V : Finset Plane) (η : FrameBoundary W)
    (σ : PlaneConfiguration W) : Weight (PlaneConfiguration V) :=
  marginal (conditionOn (planeLaw κ W η) (fun τ => ∀ x ∈ W \ V, extendLetters τ x = extendLetters σ x))
    (fun τ x => extendLetters τ x.val)

name: AKLT.Defs.conditionalTorusLaw
doc: Conditional block law on a finite torus product, indexed only by sites of U.
source:
def conditionalTorusLaw (L N : AKLT.Challenge.Size) (κ : AKLT.Challenge.Site L N → Fin 3)
    (U : Finset (AKLT.Challenge.Site L N)) (σ : TorusConfiguration L N) :
    Weight (U → IcoLetter) :=
  marginal (conditionOn (torusLaw L N κ) (AgreeOutside U σ)) (fun τ x => τ x.val)

name: AKLT.Defs.sitesInVolume
doc: The physical set corresponding to a subvolume of a finite plane product.
source: def sitesInVolume (W V : Finset Plane) : Finset W := Finset.univ.filter fun x => x.val ∈ V

name: AKLT.Defs.ParallelClearance
doc:
`l:shellgeom`: clearance for each pair of parallel sides, expressed in coordinates.
Only a shell side that actually meets the physical square is quantified.
source:
def ParallelClearance (a y : Plane) (u : ℕ) (i : ℤ) : Prop :=
  ∀ axis : Fin 2, ∀ ε δ : ℤ, (ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1) → (δ = 1 ∨ δ = -1) →
    let coord := fun z : Plane => if axis = 0 then z.1 else z.2
    let b := coord y + ε * shellRadius u i
    (∃ z ∈ square a u, coord z = b ∧ (supDist z y : ℤ) = shellRadius u i) →
      shellSpacing u / 3 ≤ ((u : ℤ) + 1 - δ * (b - coord a) : ℤ)

name: AKLT.Defs.Phase
doc: `d:phaseweights`: four phases, unrelated to the pair types B and C.
source:
inductive Phase where
  | A | B | C | D
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

name: AKLT.Defs.phaseTerminal
doc: `d:phaseweights`: terminal rewards 0,0,1,1.
source: def phaseTerminal : Phase → ℚ | .A => 0 | .B => 0 | .C => 1 | .D => 1

name: AKLT.Defs.phaseInitial
doc: `d:phaseweights`: one unit in A and B initially.
source: def phaseInitial : Phase → ℚ | .A => 1 | .B => 1 | .C => 0 | .D => 0

name: AKLT.Defs.phaseDiagonal
doc: `d:phaseweights`: the four diagonal rows, with weight 1/5 at a revisit.
source:
def phaseDiagonal (φ : Phase) (k : StepKind) : ℚ :=
  if k = .revisit then 1 / 5 else
    match φ, k with
    | .A, .straight | .B, .straight | .C, .straight => passageFactor true / 3
    | .A, .turn => passageFactor false / 3
    | _, _ => 1 / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.phaseTransition
doc: `d:phaseweights`: the only two allowed changes of phase.
source:
def phaseTransition (k : StepKind) (reward : ℚ) (φ ψ : Phase) : ℚ :=
  if φ = ψ then phaseDiagonal φ k else
    if φ = .A ∧ ψ = .C ∧ k = .turn then passageFactor false * reward / 3 else
    if φ = .B ∧ ψ = .D ∧ k = .straight then passageFactor true * reward / 3 else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.relaxedReward
doc: Type-dependent h reward when a chosen set of neighbours is declared dead.

name: AKLT.Defs.freeCoefficient
doc: `d:stationary-walk`: free operator without spatial or known-site rules.

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryCoefficient
doc: `d:stationary-walk`: exact stationary coefficients, with permanent initial-bond rules.
source:
def stationaryCoefficient {m q : ℕ} (Q : MemoryQuotient m q) (X : PairType) (d₀ : Compass)
    (φ : Phase) (a : Fin q) (x : Plane) (d : Compass) (ψ : Phase) : ℚ :=
  if x = kernelCentre ∨ x = kernelTarget X ∨ Q.allowed a d = false then 0 else
    if x = kernelStart ∨ x = kernelStart + d₀.step then
      if ({x, x + d.step} : Finset Plane) = {kernelStart, kernelStart + d₀.step} ∨
        Q.kind a d = .revisit then 0 else if φ = ψ then 1 / 5 else 0
    else if x + d.step = kernelCentre then 0 else
      phaseTransition (Q.kind a d)
        (relaxedReward x (Q.arrival a) d {kernelCentre}) φ ψ

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryApply
doc: `d:stationary-walk`: nonnegative backward operator on the actual infinite lattice.
source:
def stationaryApply {m q : ℕ} (Q : MemoryQuotient m q) (X : PairType) (d₀ : Compass)
    (F : Phase → Fin q → Plane → ℚ) (φ : Phase) (a : Fin q) (x : Plane) : ℚ :=
  ∑ d : Compass, ∑ ψ : Phase,
    stationaryCoefficient Q X d₀ φ a x d ψ * F ψ (Q.successor a d) (x + d.step)

name: AKLT.Defs.freeApply
doc: `d:stationary-walk`: the position-free backward operator W.

name: AKLT.Defs.certificateRadius
doc: `d:stationary-certificate`: the frozen spatial radius.
source: def certificateRadius : ℕ := 70

name: AKLT.Defs.certificateValueScale
doc: The value scale, separate from the coefficient scale.
source: def certificateValueScale : ℕ := 2 ^ 16

name: AKLT.Defs.certificateCoefficientScale
doc: The independently rounded coefficient scale.
source: def certificateCoefficientScale : ℕ := 2 ^ 48

name: AKLT.Defs.coefficientCeiling
doc: Exact rational coefficient ceiling, never a floating point diagnostic.
source: def coefficientCeiling (t : ℚ) : ℕ := ⌈(certificateCoefficientScale : ℚ) * t⌉₊

name: AKLT.Defs.StationaryData
doc: `d:stationary-certificate`: finite integer arrays; passing their checks is a separate Prop.
source:
structure StationaryData (q : ℕ) where
  cap : Phase → Fin q → ℕ
  value : Phase → Fin q → square (0, 0) certificateRadius → ℕ

name: AKLT.Defs.StationaryData.extended
doc: The global extension is capped outside the finite square, without spatial periodicity.
source:
def StationaryData.extended {q : ℕ} (C : StationaryData q)
    (φ : Phase) (a : Fin q) (x : Plane) : ℕ := by
  classical
  exact if h : x ∈ square (0, 0) certificateRadius then C.value φ a ⟨x, h⟩ else C.cap φ a

name: AKLT.Defs.StationaryData.potential
doc: `d:stationary-certificate`: the finite-valued rational potential on all lattice sites.

name: AKLT.Defs.StationaryData.Passes
doc: `d:stationary-certificate`: all integer free rows, caps, terminal values and local rows.
source:
def StationaryData.Passes {m q : ℕ} (C : StationaryData q) (Q : MemoryQuotient m q)
    (X : PairType) (d₀ : Compass) : Prop :=
  (∀ φ a, 0 < C.cap φ a) ∧
  (∀ a, certificateValueScale ≤ C.cap .C a ∧ certificateValueScale ≤ C.cap .D a) ∧
  (∀ φ a, (∑ d : Compass, ∑ ψ : Phase,
    coefficientCeiling (freeCoefficient Q φ a d ψ) * C.cap ψ (Q.successor a d)) ≤
      certificateCoefficientScale * C.cap φ a) ∧
  (∀ φ a x, C.value φ a x ≤ C.cap φ a) ∧
  (∀ φ a, C.extended φ a kernelCentre = 0 ∧
    (C.extended φ a (kernelTarget X) : ℚ) = certificateValueScale * phaseTerminal φ) ∧
  ∀ φ a (x : square (0, 0) certificateRadius),
    x.val ≠ kernelCentre → x.val ≠ kernelTarget X →
    (∑ d : Compass, ∑ ψ : Phase,
      coefficientCeiling (stationaryCoefficient Q X d₀ φ a x.val d ψ) *
        C.extended ψ (Q.successor a d) (x.val + d.step)) ≤
      certificateCoefficientScale * C.value φ a x

name: AKLT.Defs.prefixPhases
doc: Actual phase weights along a true prefix, with its true revisits and dead neighbours.

name: AKLT.Defs.FirstDirection
doc: A first direction, also total for an empty word (where it is false).
source:
def FirstDirection {n : ℕ} (w : DirectionWord n) (d : Compass) : Prop :=
  ∃ i : Fin n, i.val = 0 ∧ w i = d

name: AKLT.Defs.SurvivingPrefix
doc: `d:prefix-bound`: true surviving prefixes avoid both the centre and the target.

name: AKLT.Defs.firstDirectionPartialRow
doc: Finite first-direction h-weighted closed-trail sum.
source:
def firstDirectionPartialRow (X : PairType) (d₀ : Compass) (R : ℕ) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 R, ∑ w : DirectionWord n,
    if ClosedTrail X w ∧ FirstDirection w d₀ then closedContribution w else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryPrefixBound
doc:
`d:prefix-bound`: exact short-order sum plus all surviving length-twelve phase prefixes.
A hit at time twelve belongs only to the short sum.
source:
def stationaryPrefixBound (Q : MemoryQuotient 10 3741) (X : PairType) (d₀ : Compass)
    (C : StationaryData 3741) : ℚ := by
  classical
  exact firstDirectionPartialRow X d₀ 12 +
    ∑ w : DirectionWord 12, if SurvivingPrefix X d₀ w then
      ∑ φ : Phase, prefixPhases w φ * C.potential φ (Q.project (lastWindowWord 10 w))
        (wordVertex kernelStart w 12) else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.stationaryCases
doc: `p:stationary-check`: the five cases, with no symmetry reduction for row C.

name: AKLT.Defs.localThreshold

source: def localThreshold : Bool → ℚ := fun straight => if straight then 961 / 1000 else 187 / 200

name: AKLT.Defs.passageFactor

source: def passageFactor (straight : Bool) : ℚ := (localThreshold straight)⁻¹

name: AKLT.Defs.alphaBound

name: AKLT.Defs.betaBound

name: AKLT.Defs.DirectionWord
doc: `d:weights`: a finite direction word; there is no spatial quotient.
source: abbrev DirectionWord (n : ℕ) := Fin n → Compass

name: AKLT.Defs.wordVertex
doc: The j-th vertex of a word, with a clamped natural index for convenient prefix definitions.
source:
def wordVertex {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) (j : ℕ) : Plane :=
  u + ∑ i : Fin n, if i.val < j then (w i).step else 0

name: AKLT.Defs.wordBond
doc: The unoriented edge at a departure.
source:
def wordBond {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Finset Plane :=
  {wordVertex u w i.val, wordVertex u w (i.val + 1)}

name: AKLT.Defs.IsTrail
doc: `d:weights`: distinct unoriented bonds and the forbidden initial reversal.
source:
def IsTrail {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (incoming : Compass) (w : DirectionWord n) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (wordBond u w) ∧ ∀ i : Fin n, i.val = 0 → w i ≠ incoming.reverse

name: AKLT.Defs.wordIncoming
doc: Incoming direction at a departure, including the designated virtual first bond.
source:
def wordIncoming {n : ℕ} (incoming : Compass) (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Compass :=
  if h : i.val = 0 then incoming else w ⟨i.val - 1, by omega⟩

name: AKLT.Defs.wordStraight
doc: A straight departure compares actual outgoing and incoming directions.
source:
def wordStraight {n : ℕ} (incoming : Compass) (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (w i = wordIncoming incoming w i)

name: AKLT.Defs.departureCount
doc: Departure count before index i; arrivals alone do not count as revisits.
source:
def departureCount {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) (i : ℕ) (x : Plane) : ℕ :=
  ((Finset.range (min i n)).filter fun j => wordVertex u w j = x).card

name: AKLT.Defs.wordRevisit
doc: `d:weights`: true revisit means a previous departure from the same site.
source:
def wordRevisit {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) (i : Fin n) : Bool :=
  decide (0 < departureCount u w i.val (wordVertex u w i.val))

name: AKLT.Defs.trailWeight
doc: `d:weights`: the true lattice trail weight, including the revisit factor 1/5.
source:
def trailWeight {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (incoming : Compass) (w : DirectionWord n) : ℚ :=
  ∏ i, if wordRevisit u w i then 1 / 5 else passageFactor (wordStraight incoming w i) / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.trailBaseWeight
doc: The mass-free coefficient before exposure products, equal to 3^-n(3/5)^rev.
source:
def trailBaseWeight {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) : ℚ :=
  ∏ i, if wordRevisit u w i then 1 / 5 else 1 / 3

name: AKLT.Defs.OpenTrailBound
doc: `h:H2`: every finite-length sum, with arbitrary start and designated incoming direction.
source:
def OpenTrailBound (CV q : ℝ) : Prop := by
  classical
  exact
  1 ≤ CV ∧ 0 < q ∧ q < 1 ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ u : Plane, ∀ incoming : Compass,
    (∑ w : DirectionWord n, if IsTrail u incoming w then (trailWeight u incoming w : ℝ) else 0) ≤
      CV * q ^ n

name: AKLT.Defs.certifiedRate
doc: `t:inputs`: the selected exact memory-six rate.

name: AKLT.Defs.wordVertices
doc: A vertex-list view of a finite word for the network trace.
source:
def wordVertices {n : ℕ} (u : Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) : List Plane :=
  (List.range (n + 1)).map (wordVertex u w)

name: AKLT.Defs.StoppedNetworkTrail
doc:
`d:trace`: finite stopped trails of present distinct bonds, with no departure from S.
The original finite bond set bounds the length, so this class is finitely enumerable.
source:
def StoppedNetworkTrail {G : Finset Plane} {n : ℕ} (D : Network G) (u : Plane)
    (T : Finset Plane) (w : DirectionWord n) : Prop :=
  Function.Injective (wordBond u w) ∧
  (∀ i : Fin n, D.Present (wordVertex u w i.val) (wordVertex u w (i.val + 1))) ∧
  (∀ j < n, wordVertex u w j ∉ T ∧ wordVertex u w j ∉ protectedSites G) ∧
  wordVertex u w n ∈ T

name: AKLT.Defs.stoppedNetworkTrails
doc: `d:trace`: each fixed-length part of T_D(u,T), generated directly from direction words.
source:
def stoppedNetworkTrails {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (u : Plane) (T : Finset Plane)
    (n : ℕ) : Finset (DirectionWord n) := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.filter (StoppedNetworkTrail D u T)

name: AKLT.Defs.AdmissibleTarget
doc: `p:pairwalk`: precisely the target degree restriction, including original legs.
source:
def AdmissibleTarget {G : Finset Plane} (D : Network G) (v : Plane) : Prop :=
  v ∈ D.active ∧
    ((D.status v = .U ∧ (D.presentNeighbours v).card +
      ((originalLegs G).filter fun e => e.1 = v).card ≤ 3) ∨
    (D.status v = .D ∧ (D.presentNeighbours v).card ≤ 1))

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.mainV2_of_parts
doc:
`t:main`: compose t:inputs, t:rec, t:cutMOS and t:mainW, then supply the
independent p:toruskernel at every size. This proves the assembly implication only.
source:
theorem mainV2_of_parts : InputsStatement → RecStatement → CutMOSStatement →
    MainWStatement → TorusKernelStatement → MainStatementV2 := by
  intro hInputs hRec hCut hMainW hKernel
  obtain ⟨θ, ρ, _, _, _, _, _, hP⟩ := hRec 10 (certifiedRate : ℝ)
    hInputs.1 hInputs.2.1 hInputs.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨Mstar, hW⟩ := hCut (renewalAmplitude 10 (certifiedRate : ℝ) ρ) θ hP
  obtain ⟨c, hc, L₀, hL₀, hEventual⟩ := hMainW ⟨64, cutProbability
    (renewalAmplitude 10 (certifiedRate : ℝ) ρ) θ, Mstar, hW⟩
  constructor
  · intro L N
    exact ⟨(hKernel L N).2.2.2.1, (hKernel L N).2.2.2.2.1⟩
  · exact ⟨c, hc, L₀, hL₀, fun L N hL hN => (hEventual L N hL hN).2⟩

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.LogMeanBoundsStatement
doc:
`l:log-mean-bounds`: positive-variable monotonicity, the exact eight-term enclosure,
and every rational endpoint check for both amended rows.
source:
def LogMeanBoundsStatement : Prop :=
  reciprocalLogMean 1 = 1 ∧
  (∀ c : ℝ, 3 / 5 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → ∀ x x' y y' : ℝ,
    0 < x → x ≤ x' → 0 < y → y ≤ y' →
    1 / (3 * logarithmicMean (c * x') y') - 1 / (5 * logarithmicMean x' y') ≤
      1 / (3 * logarithmicMean (c * x) y) - 1 / (5 * logarithmicMean x y)) ∧
  (∀ c x y : ℝ, 3 / 5 ≤ c → c ≤ 1 → 116 / 125 ≤ x → 1 ≤ y →
    1 / (3 * logarithmicMean (c * x) y) - 1 / (5 * logarithmicMean x y) ≤
      reciprocalLogMean ((116 / 125) * c) / 3 - reciprocalLogMean (116 / 125) / 5) ∧
  (∀ s : ℚ, 0 < s → s < 1 → (logMeanLower s : ℝ) ≤ reciprocalLogMean s ∧
    reciprocalLogMean s ≤ (logMeanUpper s : ℝ)) ∧
  ∀ straight : Bool,
    logMeanUpper ((116 / 125) * localThreshold straight) / 3 - logMeanLower (116 / 125) / 5 ≤
      alphaBound straight ∧
    logMeanUpper ((116 / 125) * localThreshold straight) / 3 ≤ betaBound straight ∧
    logMeanUpper (localThreshold straight) / 3 ≤ betaPrimeBound straight ∧
    0 < betaPrimeBound straight ∧ betaPrimeBound straight ≤ betaBound straight

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.ResponseStatement
doc:
`l:response`: actual uniform logarithmic identities for the two used U cases,
zero one-bond and D responses, and the free/pinned ratio bounds.
source:
def ResponseStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ G : Finset Plane, ∀ τ : PinAssignment G, ∀ D : Network G, D.Auxiliary →
    ∀ y : Plane, D.AdmissibleStart y → ∀ o ∈ D.presentNeighbours y,
    0 < stepRatio D τ false y o ∧ stepRatio D τ false y o ≤ 1 ∧
    0 < stepRatio D τ true y o ∧ stepRatio D τ true y o ≤ 12 / 5 ∧
    (D.status y = .D → stepRatio D τ true y o = 1 ∧ stepRatio D τ false y o = 1) ∧
    (D.status y = .U → (D.presentNeighbours y).card = 1 →
      stepRatio D τ true y o = 1 ∧ stepRatio D τ false y o = 1) ∧
    (∀ f : Plane, D.status y = .U → D.presentNeighbours y = {o, f} → o ≠ f →
      0 < responseBetaPrime D τ y o f ∧ responseBetaPrime D τ y o f ≤ 35510 / 100000 ∧
      Real.log (stepRatio D τ false y o) - Real.log (stepRatio D τ true y o) =
        responseBetaPrime D τ y o f *
          (removedPairMean D τ true y f o - removedPairMean D τ false y f o)) ∧
    ∀ f g : Plane, D.status y = .U → D.presentNeighbours y = {o, f, g} →
      o ≠ f → o ≠ g → f ≠ g →
      0 < responseAlpha D τ y o f g ∧ responseAlpha D τ y o f g ≤ 18094 / 100000 ∧
      0 < responseBeta D τ y o f g ∧ responseBeta D τ y o f g ≤ 36751 / 100000 ∧
      Real.log (stepRatio D τ false y o) - Real.log (stepRatio D τ true y o) =
        responseAlpha D τ y o f g * (removedPairMean D τ true y f g - removedPairMean D τ false y f g) +
        responseBeta D τ y o f g * ((removedPairMean D τ true y f o - removedPairMean D τ false y f o) +
          (removedPairMean D τ true y g o - removedPairMean D τ false y g o))

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.ResponseTypedStatement
doc:
`l:response-typed`: covered U departures satisfy both the analytic and exact
type-dependent bounds, including beta-prime when one non-outgoing neighbour is absent.
source:
def ResponseTypedStatement : Prop :=
  H1Statement →
  (∀ straight : Bool, alphaBound straight ≤ 18094 / 100000 ∧
    betaBound straight ≤ 36751 / 100000 ∧ betaPrimeBound straight ≤ 36751 / 100000) ∧
  ∀ G : Finset Plane, ∀ τ : PinAssignment G, ∀ D : Network G, D.Auxiliary →
    ∀ y : Plane, D.AdmissibleStart y → D.status y = .U →
    ∀ incoming outgoing : Compass, CoveredDeparture D y incoming outgoing →
    let o := y + outgoing.step
    let straight := decide (outgoing = incoming)
    (∀ f : Plane, D.presentNeighbours y = {o, f} → o ≠ f →
      0 < responseBetaPrime D τ y o f ∧
      responseBetaPrime D τ y o f ≤ (betaPrimeBound straight : ℝ) ∧
      responseBetaPrime D τ y o f ≤ reciprocalLogMean (localThreshold straight : ℝ) / 3) ∧
    ∀ f g : Plane, D.presentNeighbours y = {o, f, g} → o ≠ f → o ≠ g → f ≠ g →
      0 < responseAlpha D τ y o f g ∧ responseAlpha D τ y o f g ≤ (alphaBound straight : ℝ) ∧
      0 < responseBeta D τ y o f g ∧ responseBeta D τ y o f g ≤ (betaBound straight : ℝ) ∧
      responseBeta D τ y o f g ≤ reciprocalLogMean ((116 / 125) * (localThreshold straight : ℝ)) / 3 ∧
      responseAlpha D τ y o f g ≤ reciprocalLogMean ((116 / 125) * (localThreshold straight : ℝ)) / 3 -
        reciprocalLogMean (116 / 125) / 5 ∧
      responseI D τ true y o f g ≥ (localThreshold straight : ℝ) * responseJ D τ true y f g ∧
      responseI D τ false y o f g ≥ responseJ D τ false y f g ∧
      responseJ D τ false y f g ≥ 1 ∧ responseJ D τ true y f g ≥ 116 / 125

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.MomentsStatement
doc:
`l:moments`: twelve distinct antipodal unit atoms, exact tensors, and degree-four
orthogonal covariance, including sitewise U/D products. No arbitrary-function invariance.
source:
def MomentsStatement : Prop :=
  Function.Injective icoVector ∧ (∀ j, normSq (icoVector j) = 1) ∧
  (∀ j, ∃ k, icoVector k = -icoVector j) ∧ moment (fun _ => 1) = 1 ∧
  (∀ i, moment (fun n => n i) = 0) ∧
  (∀ i j k, moment (fun n => n i * n j * n k) = 0) ∧
  (∀ i j : Fin 3, moment (fun n => n i * n j) = if i = j then 1 / 3 else 0) ∧
  (∀ i j k l : Fin 3, moment (fun n => n i * n j * n k * n l) =
    ((if i = j ∧ k = l then 1 else 0) + (if i = k ∧ j = l then 1 else 0) +
      (if i = l ∧ j = k then 1 else 0)) / 15) ∧
  (∀ m : Fin 3 → ℕ, (∑ i, m i) ≤ 4 → ∀ s : Status, s = .U ∨ s = .D →
    siteFunctional s (fun n => ∏ i, n i ^ m i) = (rationalStatusMoment s m : ℝ)) ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ s : Fin n → Status, (∀ x, s x = .U ∨ s x = .D) →
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 3) ℝ, SeparateDegreeFour p →
    ∀ R : Fin n → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ x, (R x).transpose * R x = 1) →
    productFunctional s (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval (fun v => ((R v.1).mulVec (a v.1)) v.2) p) =
      productFunctional s (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval (fun v => a v.1 v.2) p)

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.FiniteFactsStatement
doc:
`l:finitefacts`: positivity (also at zero sites), conditional independence,
degree-admissible free scalar-product positivity, and the support norm bound.
source:
def FiniteFactsStatement : Prop :=
  (∀ s : Status, s = .U ∨ s = .D → ∀ j : SpinLetter,
    0 < spinWeight s j → normSq (spinVector j) ≤ 1) ∧
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ D : FiniteSpinNetwork n, D.Valid →
    0 < D.partition true (fun _ => 1) ∧ 0 < D.partition false (fun _ => 1) ∧
    (∀ pairs : List (Fin n × Fin n),
      (∀ x, (D.bonds.filter fun e => e.1 = x ∨ e.2 = x).card +
        (pairs.filter fun e => e.1 = x).length + (pairs.filter fun e => e.2 = x).length ≤ 4) →
      0 ≤ D.partition false (fun a => (pairs.map fun e => dot (a e.1) (a e.2)).prod)) ∧
    ∀ pinned : Bool, ∀ x y : Fin n, x ≠ y → (x, y) ∉ D.bonds → (y, x) ∉ D.bonds →
      ∀ σ : Fin n → SpinLetter,
      let E := fun τ : Fin n → SpinLetter => ∀ z, z ≠ x → z ≠ y → τ z = σ z
      let p := normalize (D.weight pinned)
      0 < eventMass p E → ∀ a b : SpinLetter,
        conditionalProbability p E (fun τ => τ x = a ∧ τ y = b) =
          conditionalProbability p E (fun τ => τ x = a) *
            conditionalProbability p E (fun τ => τ y = b)

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.ThreeFactorMeanStatement
doc:
`l:35`: both site laws have the three-factor mean bound; every vector in

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.ExactStatement
doc:
`l:exact`: finite quadrature for every polynomial of separate degree at most four,
including any selected U-to-D zero-atom mixtures. Atoms may repeat in a weighted law.
source:
def ExactStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ k : Fin n → ℕ, ∀ F : (x : Fin n) → FrameData (k x),
    (∀ x, MomentLaw (F x)) → ∀ s : Fin n → Status, (∀ x, s x = .U ∨ s x = .D) →
    ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin 3) ℝ, SeparateDegreeFour p →
    let atom : (x : Fin n) → Option (Fin (k x)) → Vec3 := fun x j =>
      match j with | none => (0 : Vec3) | some i => (F x).point i
    let weight : (x : Fin n) → Option (Fin (k x)) → ℝ := fun x j =>
      match j with
      | none => if s x = .D then (2 / 5 : ℝ) else 0
      | some i => (if s x = .D then (3 / 5 : ℝ) else 1) * (F x).weight i
    (∑ a : (x : Fin n) → Option (Fin (k x)),
      (∏ x, weight x (a x)) * MvPolynomial.eval (fun v => atom v.1 (a v.1) v.2) p) =
      productFunctional s (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval (fun v => a v.1 v.2) p)

name: AKLT.Blueprint.Top.ALMStatement
doc: `l:alm`: true window-mass domination and the exact finite base-constant implication.
source:
def ALMStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
    (∀ n : ℕ, m ≤ n → ∀ u : Plane, ∀ incoming : Compass, ∀ ω' : MemoryWindow m,
      memoryTrailMass m (n + 1) u incoming ω' ≤

    ∀ v : MemoryWindow m → ℝ, (∀ ω, 0 < v ω) → ∀ q : ℝ, 0 < q → q < 1 →
      (∀ ω, (∑ ω', (memoryMatrix m ω ω' : ℝ) * v ω') ≤ q * v ω) →
      OpenTrailBound (memoryBaseConstant m q v) q ∧
      ∀ CV : ℝ, memoryBaseConstant m q v ≤ CV → OpenTrailBound CV q
